rule.title: Executable SVG exposure
rule.recommendation: Prefer `` for SVG images; if SVG must be served directly, use attachment disposition and a CSP that blocks scripts and objects.

rule.title: Activity wraps an effect-heavy subtree
rule.recommendation: Check what's under `<Activity>`. Every hide and show rebuilds every Effect inside from scratch. Move subscriptions and effect-driven setState out of the Activity, or load the data above it.

rule.title: Listener re-subscribes on every handler change
rule.recommendation: Store the handler in a ref and have the listener read `handlerRef.current()`. The subscription stays put while the latest handler still runs.

rule.title: Agent tool exposes dangerous capability
rule.recommendation: Treat tool inputs as prompt-injection controlled. Validate arguments, scope permissions per call, and avoid exposing shell/file/network primitives directly to agents.

rule.title: Image missing alt text
rule.recommendation: Give every meaningful image an `alt`, `aria-label`, or `aria-labelledby`.

rule.title: Ambiguous link text
rule.recommendation: Name where a link goes. Avoid 'click here', 'learn more', and 'link'.

rule.title: Anchor has no content
rule.recommendation: Put readable text inside every link.

rule.title: Anchor used as a button
rule.recommendation: Give links a real destination. Use `<button>` for in-page actions.

rule.title: Fragment link target is missing
rule.recommendation: Add an element with the referenced id, or update the fragment link to point to an existing target.

rule.title: aria-activedescendant missing tabindex
rule.recommendation: Add `tabIndex` so keyboard users can reach elements that use `aria-activedescendant`.

rule.title: Braille-only accessible description
rule.recommendation: Pair braille-specific labels and role descriptions with an equivalent accessible name or role description.

rule.title: Invalid ARIA attribute
rule.recommendation: Only use `aria-*` attributes that actually exist.

rule.title: Invalid ARIA attribute value
rule.recommendation: Give each `aria-*` attribute the kind of value it expects.

rule.title: Invalid ARIA role
rule.recommendation: Use a real, non-abstract ARIA role so assistive tech can expose the element correctly.

rule.title: ARIA on unsupported element
rule.recommendation: Do not put `role` or `aria-*` on reserved HTML elements.

rule.title: BaaS authority map shipped in browser artifact
rule.recommendation: Client BaaS config is often public, but shipped collection names plus owner, role, tenant, or admin fields give attackers a precise authorization map. Verify rules/RLS enforce every boundary server-side.

rule.title: Server env leaked to browser artifact
rule.recommendation: Treat public env prefixes as publication, not secrecy; keep secret env vars server-only and rebuild after rotating leaked keys.

rule.title: Secret shipped in browser artifact
rule.recommendation: Remove the secret from client bundles/static assets, rotate it, and route privileged service calls through server-only code.

rule.title: await inside a loop
rule.recommendation: Collect the items, then use `await Promise.all(items.map(...))` so independent work runs at the same time

rule.title: await before an early-return guard
rule.recommendation: Move the `await` below the early-return guard so the skip path stays fast and avoids unnecessary async work.

rule.title: Independent awaits run sequentially
rule.recommendation: Use `const [a, b] = await Promise.all([fetchA(), fetchB()])` so independent calls run at the same time

rule.title: Auth token in web storage
rule.recommendation: Don't persist auth tokens (JWTs, access/refresh tokens, secrets) in `localStorage`/`sessionStorage`; they're readable by any XSS. Use an `HttpOnly` cookie set by the server.

rule.title: Invalid autocomplete value
rule.recommendation: Use a valid autofill token in `autoComplete` so browsers can fill the right field reliably.

rule.title: Build pipeline runs code near secrets
rule.recommendation: Run dependency installs with scripts disabled before exposing secrets, isolate untrusted build code, and move signing/deploy authority into a narrow privileged step.

rule.title: Button missing explicit type
rule.recommendation: Set an explicit button `type` so plain buttons do not submit forms by accident: `type="button"`, `"submit"`, or `"reset"`.

rule.title: Checked input without onChange
rule.recommendation: Add `onChange`, `readOnly`, or `defaultChecked` so React knows whether the checkbox is editable, display-only, or uncontrolled.

rule.title: Class component acquires a resource with no teardown
rule.recommendation: Release listeners and timers acquired in `componentDidMount`/`constructor` by adding a `componentWillUnmount` that removes them (or use MobX `disposeOnUnmount`).

rule.title: Click handler missing keyboard handler
rule.recommendation: Pair `onClick` with a key handler so keyboard users can trigger it.

rule.title: Redirect or frame boundary risk
rule.recommendation: Allowlist redirect origins/paths, set `frame-ancestors` for privileged pages, and avoid URL-prefilled privileged dialogs.

rule.title: Unversioned localStorage key
rule.recommendation: Put a version in the storage key (e.g. "myKey:v1"). If you change the data shape later, old saved data can be ignored instead of crashing the app.

rule.title: Non-passive scroll listener
rule.recommendation: Add `{ passive: true }` as the third argument: `addEventListener('touchmove', handler, { passive: true })`. Only do this if the handler doesn't call `event.preventDefault()`, since passive listeners ignore it (which breaks pull-to-refresh, custom gestures, and nested scrolling).

rule.title: Command execution uses caller-shaped input
rule.recommendation: Avoid shell execution for caller-controlled values. Use fixed commands, argument arrays, strict allowlists, and no shell interpolation.

rule.title: Context value from an unmemoized local literal
rule.recommendation: Memoize the context value in component scope so consumers do not redraw every render. For mapped providers, extract each item into a child component and memoize there.

rule.title: Control missing accessible label
rule.recommendation: Give every interactive control a label screen readers can read.

rule.title: Broad cookie or credentialed CORS trust
rule.recommendation: Keep auth cookies host-only and HttpOnly, avoid credentialed CORS for less-trusted docs/vendor origins, and isolate documentation domains from app sessions.

rule.title: HTML injection sink with dynamic content
rule.recommendation: Prefer rendering structured React nodes. If HTML is required, sanitize with a well-reviewed sanitizer and keep the trust boundary close to the sink.

rule.title: Data table has no accessible name
rule.recommendation: Give data tables a concise caption, or reference an existing visible title with aria-labelledby.

rule.title: Memoized debounce never cancelled on unmount
rule.recommendation: A debounced/throttled callback holds a pending timer that still fires after unmount, so add `useEffect(() => () => debounced.cancel(), [debounced])` to cancel the trailing invocation when the component tears down.

rule.title: Em dash in JSX text
rule.recommendation: Replace em dashes in UI text with commas, colons, semicolons, or parentheses so the copy reads less like AI output.

rule.title: Redundant padding axes
rule.recommendation: Collapse matching padding axes to `p-N` so duplicated classes do not make spacing harder to scan; keep split axes only when breakpoints differ.

rule.title: Redundant width and height axes
rule.recommendation: Collapse matching width and height to `size-N` so duplicated classes do not make layout harder to scan.

rule.title: space-* utility on flex children
rule.recommendation: Use `gap-*` on the flex or grid parent. `space-x-*` and `space-y-*` leave gaps when a child is hidden, miss spacing on wrapped lines, and don't flip in right-to-left layouts.

rule.title: Three dots instead of ellipsis
rule.recommendation: Use the real ellipsis character ("…") so UI labels look polished and consistent instead of like three separate periods.

rule.title: Vague button label
rule.recommendation: Name the action: "Save changes" instead of "Continue", "Send invite" instead of "Submit". The label is the button's accessible name.

rule.title: Details disclosure has no explicit summary
rule.recommendation: Make a meaningful summary the first child of details so users can understand and operate the disclosure.

rule.title: Dialog without accessible name
rule.recommendation: Give every `<dialog>` / `role="dialog"` an accessible name with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` (referencing the dialog's title element).

rule.title: Component missing display name
rule.recommendation: Give each component a `displayName` so DevTools shows a clear name.

rule.title: Effect cleanup does not match its event listener
rule.recommendation: Pass the same callback binding and capture flag to `addEventListener` and `removeEventListener`, or abort the registration's local AbortController during cleanup.

rule.title: Effect cleanup removes the wrong listener reference
rule.recommendation: Removal APIs match by reference identity, so the second inline function passed to the remove call can never equal the one you added; hoist the handler into a single named const (or useCallback) and pass that same reference to both the add and remove calls.

rule.title: Effect subscription or timer never cleaned up
rule.recommendation: Return a cleanup function that stops the subscription or timer: `return () => target.removeEventListener(name, handler)` for listeners, `return () => clearInterval(id)` or `clearTimeout(id)` for timers, `return () => observer.disconnect()` for observers, `return () => socket.close()` for connections, or `return unsubscribe` if the subscribe call already gave you one.

rule.title: Observer created in an effect never disconnected
rule.recommendation: Return a cleanup function that calls `observer.disconnect()` (or `observer.unobserve(node)`) so the observer stops firing callbacks against detached nodes after unmount instead of leaking on every mount.

rule.title: requestAnimationFrame loop never cancelled
rule.recommendation: Store the frame id and return a cleanup that calls `cancelAnimationFrame(id)` so self-scheduling work cannot continue after unmount.

rule.title: removeEventListener called with a fresh inline handler
rule.recommendation: Removal APIs match the listener by reference equality, so a fresh inline arrow, function expression, or `.bind(...)` result can never equal the registered handler; hoist the handler into a named const and pass that same reference to both the add and remove calls.

rule.title: Table header has no accessible text
rule.recommendation: Give every table header concise text or an explicit accessible name.

rule.title: Missing effect dependencies
Non-inlinable process.env access (Expo)
rule.recommendation: Read env vars with static dotted access (`process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_NAME`). Computed access and destructuring aren't inlined by babel-preset-expo and resolve to `undefined` at runtime.

rule.title: Fieldset group has no legend
rule.recommendation: Name grouped controls with a direct legend, or an explicit accessible name when no visible group label is appropriate.

rule.title: Client writes authorization field
rule.recommendation: Derive authority fields on the server or enforce them in Firebase/Supabase rules; never trust client-provided owner, org, or role values.

rule.title: Permissive Firebase security rule
rule.recommendation: Bind every read/write to `request.auth.uid`, immutable ownership, and tenant membership instead of treating sign-in as authorization.

rule.title: Firestore query filter used as authorization
rule.recommendation: Make sure Firestore rules compare the requested document against `request.auth.uid` and trusted membership data.

rule.title: Blocked component prop bypasses API contract
rule.recommendation: Configure blocked component props so callers cannot bypass the component API contract.

rule.title: Blocked DOM prop bypasses project contract
rule.recommendation: Configure blocked DOM props so plain HTML tags stay on the agreed DOM API surface.

rule.title: Blocked element bypasses approved UI primitives
rule.recommendation: Configure blocked elements so code stays on the approved UI primitives.

rule.title: Form control is omitted from named submission data
rule.recommendation: Give each data-bearing native control inside a form a stable name for FormData, autofill, and non-JavaScript submission.

rule.title: forwardRef without ref parameter
rule.recommendation: Accept the `ref` parameter or drop `forwardRef` so parents are not promised a ref that never reaches the node.

rule.title: Git provider URL built from interpolation
rule.recommendation: Validate owner, repo, org, and branch identifiers against strict slugs and build URLs with URL/path encoders instead of raw interpolation.

rule.title: Heading has no content
rule.recommendation: Put readable text in every heading.

rule.title: Hook import alias disables hook lint checks
rule.recommendation: Keep a recognised `use*` name in custom-hook aliases, reserve bare `use` for React's `use` hook, and do not rename React hooks with name-specific lint semantics such as `useEffect`, `useImperativeHandle`, or `useEffectEvent`.

rule.title: useState not destructured
rule.recommendation: Destructure `useState` as `const [thing, setThing] = useState(…)` so state reads and writes stay visible together.

rule.title: NaN in a hook dependency array
rule.recommendation: Remove `NaN` (or `Number.NaN`) from the dependency array. If a value can be NaN at runtime, normalise it (`Number.isNaN(x) ? 0 : x`) before passing it.

rule.title: html element missing lang
rule.recommendation: Set `<html lang="…">` so screen readers know the page language.

rule.title: Label wraps multiple native controls
rule.recommendation: Associate each label with one native control; use fieldset and legend to name a group of controls.

rule.title: Block element inside a paragraph
rule.recommendation:
Swap the `

` for a `

`, or move the child outside the paragraph.

rule.title: Invalid table element nesting
rule.recommendation: Put each table element in its required parent: `<thead>`/`<tbody>`/`<tfoot>` directly inside `<table>`, `<tr>` inside a row group, `<td>`/`<th>` inside `<tr>`. Browsers quietly fix broken table markup, so write it to spec.

rule.title: Form nested inside another form
rule.recommendation: Keep forms separate, or make the inner action a button associated with the outer form. HTML does not permit form descendants inside a form.

rule.title: Interactive control contains another focusable control
rule.recommendation: Move the inner control beside its interactive ancestor so each action has independent semantics and focus behavior.

rule.title: Conflicting document language declarations
rule.recommendation: Use matching base languages for lang and xml:lang on the root html element.

rule.title: iframe missing title
rule.recommendation: Add a descriptive `title` so screen reader users know what the embedded frame contains.

rule.title: iframe missing sandbox attribute
rule.recommendation: Add `sandbox=""` or a curated value so embedded pages cannot get full access to your site by default.

rule.title: Frame title is duplicated
rule.recommendation: Give each frame a concise title that distinguishes its purpose from sibling frames.

rule.title: Redundant words in image alt
rule.recommendation: Do not put 'image' or 'photo' in alt text. Describe what is shown.

rule.title: Imported metadata reaches code execution
rule.recommendation: Parse imported metadata as data with strict schemas; do not evaluate EXIF, manifests, presets, dropped files, or archives.

rule.title: Ctrl-C handler is unreachable
rule.recommendation: Pass `{exitOnCtrlC: false}` to `render()` before handling Ctrl-C with `useInput`.

rule.title: Retired: Ink Newline placement
rule.recommendation: No change is required; Ink supports standalone `<Newline>` elements.

rule.title: Process exits before Ink cleanup
rule.recommendation: Use Ink's `useApp().exit()` so Ink restores terminal state.

rule.title: Raw mode changed during render
rule.recommendation: Move `useStdin().setRawMode()` to an effect and restore it in cleanup.

rule.title: DOM element used in an Ink tree
rule.recommendation: Use Ink primitives such as `<Box>` and `<Text>` instead of DOM host elements.

rule.title: DOM router used in an Ink tree
rule.recommendation: Use React Router's memory router APIs in Ink applications.

rule.title: Ink focus changed during render
rule.recommendation: Move focus-manager calls to an effect or input handler.

rule.title: Layout component nested in Ink Text
rule.recommendation: Move Ink layout components outside `<Text>` and `<Transform>` boundaries.

rule.title: Inert input hook used during string rendering
rule.recommendation: Keep input subscriptions out of components used only by `renderToString()`.

rule.title: Ink element measured during render
rule.recommendation: Measure Ink elements in a layout effect, effect, callback ref, or event handler.

rule.title: Multiple unconditional Static regions in one render root
rule.recommendation: Combine unconditional output in one render root into a single `<Static>`.

rule.title: Raw text outside Ink Text
rule.recommendation: Wrap terminal text in Ink's `<Text>` component.

rule.title: Ink render reused before unmount
rule.recommendation: Call Ink `render()` once and update or rerender the returned instance.

rule.title: Animation loop implemented with setInterval
rule.recommendation: Use Ink's shared `useAnimation()` scheduler and automatic unmount cleanup.

rule.title: Paste interpreted through useInput
rule.recommendation: Use Ink's `usePaste()` for bracketed multi-character paste input.

rule.title: Static receives a non-append-only collection
rule.recommendation: Pass `<Static>` a collection whose existing entries never reorder or disappear.

rule.title: Static item root missing a key
rule.recommendation: Put a stable `key` on the root element returned by `<Static>`.

rule.title: Retired: Ink Suspense rendering mode
rule.recommendation: No change is required; Ink can render Suspense fallbacks without concurrency.

rule.title: Terminal dimensions read non-reactively
rule.recommendation: Use Ink's `useWindowSize()` so resize events trigger a render.

rule.title: String length used as terminal column width
rule.recommendation: Measure terminal columns with `string-width` before calling `setCursorPosition`.

rule.title: Interactive child process bypasses Ink suspension
rule.recommendation: Run inherited-TTY child processes inside `useApp().suspendTerminal()`.

rule.title: Invalid Ink accessibility semantics
rule.recommendation: Use a role supported by Ink and do not label elements hidden from screen readers.

rule.title: Weak cryptography in security context
rule.recommendation: Use modern primitives, `crypto.randomBytes` / Web Crypto randomness, and timing-safe comparisons for signatures, digests, tokens, and auth material.

rule.title: Auth cookie missing HttpOnly protection
rule.recommendation: Set auth/session cookies server-side with `httpOnly: true`, `secure: true`, and `sameSite`. Cookies set via `document.cookie` or with `httpOnly: false` are readable by any XSS payload and can be stolen.

rule.title: Interactive element not focusable
rule.recommendation: Add keyboard focus support so users can reach interactive elements without a pointer.

rule.title: Derived atom returns fresh object
rule.recommendation: Split it into one derived atom per field (each compares cleanly with Object.is), or wrap with `selectAtom(source, fn, shallow)` from jotai/utils if you really need one object.

rule.title: selectAtom called during render
rule.recommendation: Lift `selectAtom(base, fn)` to module scope, or wrap it: `const atom = useMemo(() => selectAtom(base, fn), [deps])`. Calling it during render makes a new atom every time and re-subscribes forever.

rule.title: Subscribing to raw query atom
rule.recommendation: Derive the field you read: `const dataAtom = atom((get) => get(queryAtom).data)`. Subscribing to the whole query atom re-renders on every refetch, focus, or no-op cache hit.

rule.title: Async reduce drops its accumulator
rule.recommendation: Await the accumulator first: `const acc = await previous; ...; return acc;`. Seed it with `Promise.resolve(initial)` so the first run also gets a Promise

rule.title: Repeated inline style writes
rule.recommendation: Do all your reads first, then all your writes. Mixing them inside a loop makes the browser recalculate the layout again and again, which is slow

rule.title: Repeated property access in a loop
rule.recommendation: Read the value once into a variable at the top of the loop: `const { x, y } = obj.deeply.nested`

rule.title: Repeated localStorage reads
rule.recommendation: Read `localStorage`/`sessionStorage` once and reuse the value. Every read has to parse the data again, which is slow

rule.title: Chained array iterations
rule.recommendation: Combine `.map().filter()` style chains into one pass with `.reduce()` or a `for...of` loop, so you only loop over the list once

rule.title: Deeply nested if statements
rule.recommendation: Add an early `return` or `continue` so the deep nesting flattens out and you bail as soon as the answer is known

rule.title: .map().filter(Boolean) loops twice
rule.recommendation: Use `.flatMap(item => condition ? [value] : [])` to change and drop items in one pass, instead of building a throwaway array in between

rule.title: Intl formatter rebuilt each call
rule.recommendation: Move `new Intl.NumberFormat(...)` to the top of the file or wrap it in `useMemo`. Building one is slow, so don't redo it on every call

rule.title: RegExp built inside a loop
rule.recommendation: Move `new RegExp(...)` (or large regex literals) to a constant outside the loop so it isn't rebuilt on every pass

rule.title: array.find() inside a loop
rule.recommendation: Build a `Map` once before the loop instead of calling `array.find(...)` inside it

rule.title: Array compare without length check
rule.recommendation: Check `a.length === b.length && a.every((x, i) => x === b[i])` so arrays of different sizes stop right away

rule.title: sort() to find min or max
rule.recommendation: Use `Math.min(...array)` or `Math.max(...array)` instead of sorting the whole list just to read the first or last item

rule.title: Array lookup inside a loop
rule.recommendation: Use a `Set` or `Map` when you check for the same items over and over. `Array.includes`/`find` scans the whole list each time

rule.title: Spread copy before sort()
rule.recommendation: Use `array.toSorted()` (ES2023) instead of `[...array].sort()` so you sort without copying the array first

rule.title: Inconsistent boolean prop notation
rule.recommendation: Use one boolean-attribute style so equivalent true props scan the same across the codebase.

rule.title: Unnecessary curly braces in JSX
rule.recommendation: Use one JSX literal style so equivalent markup scans the same without extra JSX noise.

rule.title: JSX in disallowed file extension
rule.recommendation: Name JSX files with the configured extension so file names accurately signal which files contain JSX.

rule.title: Inconsistent fragment syntax
rule.recommendation: Use one fragment style so identical wrappers do not look different across files.

rule.title: Inconsistent event handler names
rule.recommendation: Use the `on…` prefix for event-handler props and `handle…` for handlers so readers can trace event flow.

rule.title: Missing key in list
rule.recommendation: Add a stable `key` prop so React can keep list items matched to the right data when the list changes.

rule.title: JSX nested too deeply
rule.recommendation: Pull deeply nested JSX into smaller components so it's easier to read.

rule.title: Comment rendered as JSX text
rule.recommendation: Wrap JSX comments in `{/* … */}` so users do not see comment text rendered as children.

rule.title: Unstable context provider value
rule.recommendation: Wrap the context value in `useMemo` or move it outside the component so consumers do not redraw every render.

rule.title: Duplicate props on element
rule.recommendation: Remove or rename one of the duplicate props so the later value does not silently override the earlier one.

rule.title: JSX element passed as a prop
rule.recommendation: Move the JSX outside the component or wrap it in `useMemo` so memoized children do not redraw every render.

rule.title: New array passed as a prop
rule.recommendation: Wrap the array in `useMemo` or move it outside the component so memoized children do not redraw every render.

rule.title: New function passed as a prop
rule.recommendation: Wrap the callback in `useCallback` or move it outside the component so memoized children do not redraw every render.

rule.title: New object passed as a prop
rule.recommendation: Wrap the object in `useMemo` or move it outside the component so memoized children do not redraw every render.

rule.title: javascript: URL in JSX
rule.recommendation: Use real event handlers instead of `javascript:` URLs so injected URL text cannot execute as code.

rule.title: Unsafe target=_blank link
rule.recommendation: Add `rel="noreferrer"` (or `"noopener"`) when using `target="_blank"`.

rule.title: Undefined JSX component
rule.recommendation: Import the component or fix the typo so React can resolve the JSX identifier at runtime.

rule.title: Unnecessary React fragment
rule.recommendation: Drop the fragment when it wraps a single child or sits directly under an HTML tag.

rule.title: Numeric && renders a stray 0
rule.recommendation: In `{items.length && <List/>}` React renders a literal `0` when the count is 0. Compare explicitly (`items.length > 0 && <List/>`) or use a ternary (`items.length ? <List/> : null`).

rule.title: Component name not PascalCase
rule.recommendation: Rename custom JSX components to PascalCase so React treats them as components, not intrinsic DOM tags.

rule.title: Same prop spread multiple times
rule.recommendation: Spread each value at most once so later props cannot silently override earlier props from the same object.

rule.title: Props spread onto element
rule.recommendation: List each prop explicitly so consumers can see the component API instead of receiving hidden spread props.

rule.title: JWT verified with the 'none' algorithm
rule.recommendation: Never accept the `none` algorithm; it disables signature verification and lets any forged token through. Pin the real algorithm(s) explicitly (`jwt.verify(token, key, { algorithms: ['RS256'] })`).

rule.title: Long-lived key material in repository
rule.recommendation: Remove private keys from source, rotate exposed credentials, prefer short-lived deploy credentials, and document revocation/expiry for release keys.

rule.title: Label missing associated control
rule.recommendation: Tie every label to a control with `htmlFor`, or by nesting the input.

rule.title: Invalid lang attribute value
rule.recommendation: Use a valid language code like `en` or `en-US` so screen readers choose the right pronunciation rules.

rule.title: Loading state removes its initiating action
rule.recommendation: Keep the initiating control mounted while work is pending. Disable it or mark it busy, and put the spinner or status inside the same control so focus and action identity remain stable.

rule.title: Weak localhost native bridge boundary
rule.recommendation: Use exact origin allowlists after URL parsing, per-request nonces, narrow methods, and never expose install/update commands to arbitrary web pages.

rule.title: MCP tool exposes dangerous capability
rule.recommendation: MCP tool calls run with the connecting client's authority. Validate inputs, enforce per-tool authorization, and avoid raw filesystem/shell/network access where possible.

rule.title: Server-rendered MDX can execute code
rule.recommendation: Use a constrained compiler for untrusted content, disable expressions/raw HTML, sandbox renderers, and avoid caching attacker-controlled output across tenants.

rule.title: Media missing captions
rule.recommendation: Add `<track kind="captions">` inside every `<audio>` / `<video>`.

rule.title: Unsupported MobX auto-observable inheritance
rule.recommendation: Replace inheritance with composition, or annotate inherited members explicitly with `makeObservable`.

rule.title: Invalid MobX observer wrapper order
rule.recommendation: Pass the component directly to `observer`, or apply React `memo` outside the resulting observer component.

rule.title: MobX reaction disposer discarded
rule.recommendation: Keep the disposer returned by `reaction` or `autorun` and invoke it during teardown.

rule.title: AnimatePresence unmounts with its exiting child
rule.recommendation: Keep AnimatePresence mounted and place the condition around its child so Motion can observe and animate the child leaving.

rule.title: AnimatePresence child is missing a key
rule.recommendation: Give every direct AnimatePresence child a stable key derived from its identity so Motion can track which element exits.

rule.title: AnimatePresence wait mode has multiple children
rule.recommendation: Render one direct child at a time in `mode="wait"`, or use `sync` or `popLayout` when several children can be present.

rule.title: Motion component is created during render
rule.recommendation: Create Motion components at module scope, or memoize a genuinely dynamic component factory so its identity remains stable.

rule.title: Motion drag constraints do not match the drag axis
rule.recommendation: Constrain horizontal drags with left or right bounds and vertical drags with top or bottom bounds, keeping paired bounds in ascending order.

rule.title: Imperative Motion animation runs during render
rule.recommendation: Start imperative animations from an effect or user interaction, and derive render output declaratively from props and state.

rule.title: Motion keyframes and times have different lengths
rule.recommendation: Provide one transition time for each keyframe so Motion can place every value on the animation timeline.

rule.title: Motion layout animation targets an inline element
rule.recommendation: Use inline-block, block, flex, or grid so the browser can apply Motion's transform-based layout animation.

rule.title: Motion layout ID is unstable in an iteration
rule.recommendation: Derive repeated layout IDs from stable item identity, or scope each repeated component with a LayoutGroup ID derived from the item.

rule.title: Motion transform ranges have different lengths
rule.recommendation: Give useTransform input and output ranges the same number of entries so every input stop has an output value.

rule.title: Motion value is recreated during render
rule.recommendation: Use useMotionValue inside React components, or create a manual motionValue outside the render path.

rule.title: Motion value subscription is created during render
rule.recommendation: Subscribe with useMotionValueEvent, or create the subscription in an effect and return its cleanup function.

rule.title: Mouse handler missing focus handler
rule.recommendation: Pair mouse events with keyboard ones so keyboard users are not left out.

rule.title: Async client component
rule.recommendation: Fetch data in a parent Server Component and pass it as props, or use useQuery/useSWR in the client component

rule.title: Synchronous Next.js request API access
rule.recommendation: Await `cookies()`, `headers()`, `draftMode()`, and async route `params` or `searchParams`, or unwrap their promises with React `use()`, before reading properties.

rule.title: Error boundary missing 'use client'
rule.recommendation: Add `'use client'` at the top of this file. Error boundaries must be Client Components to catch and render fallback UI

rule.title: global-error.tsx missing <html>/<body>
rule.recommendation: Wrap your error UI in `<html><body>...</body></html>`. The root layout is unmounted when global-error renders

rule.title: next/image fill image is missing sizes
rule.recommendation: Add `sizes` matching your layout so `next/image` does not assume the largest candidate and make users download oversized images.

rule.title: Inline script missing id
rule.recommendation: Add `id="descriptive-name"` so Next.js can track, deduplicate, and re-execute the script correctly

rule.title: Canonical and Open Graph URLs disagree
rule.recommendation: Use the same preferred page URL for alternates.canonical and openGraph.url so search and social previews identify one page.

rule.title: Page missing metadata for search previews
rule.recommendation: Add metadata or `generateMetadata()` so search engines and social previews get a title and description.

rule.title: Plain anchor reloads internal Next.js links
rule.recommendation: `import Link from 'next/link'` for client-side navigation, prefetching, and preserved scroll position

rule.title: Client fetch for server data
rule.recommendation: Remove 'use client' and fetch directly in the Server Component. No API round-trip, and secrets stay on the server.

rule.title: Client-side redirect for navigation
rule.recommendation: Avoid redirects inside useEffect. Use an event handler, middleware, or server-side redirect (App Router: redirect() from next/navigation; Pages Router: getServerSideProps redirect)

rule.title: Linked stylesheet bypasses Next.js CSS optimization
rule.recommendation: Import CSS directly or use CSS Modules so Next.js can bundle, order, and optimize the stylesheet.

rule.title: Default export in route handler
rule.recommendation: Replace `export default` with named HTTP method exports because Next.js ignores default exports in `route.ts`.

rule.title: Edge runtime in OG image route
rule.recommendation: Remove `export const runtime = 'edge'` from OG image files. The default Node.js runtime supports more fonts and APIs

rule.title: Google Fonts loaded via link
rule.recommendation: `import { Inter } from "next/font/google"` for self-hosting, zero layout shift, and no render-blocking requests

rule.title: Manual Google Analytics script blocks optimized loading
rule.recommendation: Use `import { GoogleAnalytics } from '@next/third-parties/google'` for automatic optimization and smaller bundles.

rule.title: next/head in App Router
rule.recommendation: Use the Metadata API because `next/head` is ignored in the App Router and meta tags will not render.

rule.title: Plain img ships unoptimized images
rule.recommendation: Use `next/image` so users get optimized formats, responsive srcsets, and lazy loading instead of oversized image downloads.

rule.title: Plain script can block Next.js rendering
rule.recommendation: Use `next/script` with `strategy="afterInteractive"` or `"lazyOnload"` so third-party scripts do not block rendering.

rule.title: Redundant polyfill script
rule.recommendation: Next.js includes polyfills for fetch, Promise, Object.assign, Array.from, and 50+ others automatically

rule.title: redirect() inside try-catch
rule.recommendation: Move `redirect()` or `notFound()` outside the try block, or rethrow in `catch`, because these APIs throw control-flow errors that catch blocks swallow.

rule.title: next/script inside next/head
rule.recommendation: Move `<Script>` outside of `<Head>`. next/script manages its own placement and ignores head context

rule.title: Side effect in GET handler
rule.recommendation: GET requests can be prefetched and are open to CSRF. Move the side effect to a POST handler.

rule.title: useSearchParams without Suspense
rule.recommendation: Wrap the component using `useSearchParams` in `<Suspense>` so the rest of the page can stay statically rendered.

rule.title: @vercel/og import instead of next/og
rule.recommendation: Use `import { ImageResponse } from "next/og"`; do not import `@vercel/og` directly because Next.js already bundles it.

rule.title: accessKey attribute used
rule.recommendation: Do not use `accessKey`. It conflicts with assistive tech shortcuts.

rule.title: State adjusted after a prop changes
rule.recommendation: Remove the adjustment effect by deriving values during render, resetting the component with a key, or updating related state in the event that changes the prop. Avoid tracking the previous prop in more state, which preserves the duplication. See https://react.dev/learn/you-might-not-need-an-effect#adjusting-some-state-when-a-prop-changes

rule.title: Long body copy is set in all caps
rule.recommendation: Use sentence case for paragraphs and reserve uppercase styling for short labels.

rule.title: Pixel arbitrary font size
rule.recommendation: Use `rem` for arbitrary font sizes (`text-[0.8125rem]`, not `text-[13px]`) so text scales with the user's root font-size preference. Pixels stay fine for `border-*` / `outline-*`.

rule.title: Document body hidden from assistive technology
rule.recommendation: Remove aria-hidden from the document body and hide only the intended subtree.

rule.title: aria-hidden on focusable element
rule.recommendation: Remove `aria-hidden` from focusable elements, or stop them being focusable, so keyboard users do not land on content screen readers hide.

rule.title: Invalid control has no error description
rule.recommendation: Connect an invalid control to its error text with aria-describedby or aria-errormessage.

rule.title: Multiplicative math on optional-chained value can be NaN
rule.recommendation: An optional chain is `undefined` when it short-circuits, so `*`/`/`/`%` on it produces `NaN`, which silently corrupts formatting and comparisons. Provide a `?? fallback` or guard the chain root before the arithmetic.

rule.title: Unguarded member access on find() result
rule.recommendation: `Array.prototype.find`/`findLast` return `undefined` when no element matches, so guard the result with optional chaining (`?.`) or a null check before reading a property, indexing, or calling it.

rule.title: Array index used as a key
rule.recommendation: Use a stable id from the item, like `key={item.id}` or `key={item.slug}`. Index keys break when the list reorders or filters.

rule.title: Array index result dereferenced without a guard
rule.recommendation: An array index read is typed `T` but is `T | undefined` at runtime, so dereferencing it on an empty list, a non-matching regex, or a short split throws. Add a length/emptiness check or optional chaining before the access.

rule.title: Array index used as a key
rule.recommendation: Use a stable `key` from your data so reordered items keep the right state and DOM.

rule.title: Status live region interrupts assistive technology
rule.recommendation: Keep `role="status"` polite. Use `role="alert"` only when an interruption is genuinely imperative.

rule.title: Async effect callback
rule.recommendation: Don't make the effect callback `async`. Define an async function inside the effect and call it, then return a real cleanup function if you need one.

rule.title: Async mutating handler without re-entry guard
rule.recommendation: An async onClick/onSubmit handler on a host control that awaits a mutating request and sets state only afterward stays interactive across the await, so a double-click fires the write twice. Add a leading `if (busy) return` guard, or set a flag before the await inside `try` and reset it in `finally` while the control is disabled.

rule.title: Content auto-scrolls forever
rule.recommendation: Keep content still so readers control the pace, or provide an accessible pause control for essential live movement.

rule.title: Autofocus on an element
rule.recommendation: Do not use `autoFocus`. It disorients users on load.

rule.title: Autoplaying media without muted
rule.recommendation: Always pair `autoPlay` with `muted` (and `playsInline`): `<video autoPlay muted loop playsInline />`. If the sound matters, drop `autoPlay` and let users start it.

rule.title: Import from a barrel file
rule.recommendation: Import from the direct path: `import { Button } from './components/Button'` instead of `./components`

rule.title: Paste blocked in an authentication field
rule.recommendation: Allow paste so people can use password managers, verification codes, assistive tools, and copied text without retyping it.

rule.title: Boolean toggle reads a stale value
rule.recommendation: Toggle boolean state with the functional updater `setX(previous => !previous)` so deferred callbacks always read the latest committed value.

rule.title: Image has no usable source
rule.recommendation: Provide a real image URL or remove the image element until an asset is available.

rule.title: Component called as a function
rule.recommendation: Render components as JSX (`<Component />`), never call them like functions (`Component(props)`). A direct call runs the component outside React and breaks hooks, state, and memoization.

rule.title: Multiple setState calls in one effect
rule.recommendation: Retired: React batches synchronous state updates from one effect into the same follow-up commit, so setter count does not prove repeated redraws.

rule.title: State updates chained through effects
rule.recommendation: Set all the related state together in the event handler that starts it, instead of having one useEffect react to a state change and set more state. See https://react.dev/learn/you-might-not-need-an-effect#chains-of-computations

rule.title: Children passed as a prop
rule.recommendation: Nest children between the tags so the rendered content is visible in JSX and cannot be hidden inside a props object.

rule.title: Overlay can be clipped by an overflow container
rule.recommendation: Render the overlay outside the clipping container, usually through a portal, or remove the clipping overflow.

rule.title: cloneElement makes child props fragile
rule.recommendation: Pass children or render props instead so parent code does not depend on fragile cloned child props.

rule.title: Request failure rendered as an empty result
rule.recommendation: Keep request failure separate from an empty successful response, render an error with a retry action, and leave the previous result visible when appropriate.

rule.title: All-literal logical chain used as a multi-value expression
rule.recommendation: Compare against each value separately (or use an array `.includes(x)`) instead of an all-literal `||`/`&&` chain, which short-circuits to its first literal and drops the rest.

rule.title: Page root uses a generic default font choice
rule.recommendation: Choose a typeface that supports the product's voice, or document why the conventional UI font is intentional.

rule.title: Motion spring mixes incompatible option modes
rule.recommendation: Choose either stiffness/damping/mass or duration/bounce for a Motion spring so every configured value takes effect.

rule.title: Controlled input value is a fixed literal
rule.recommendation: Drive the input's `value` from state (`const [value, setValue] = useState(...)`) that `onChange` updates, or drop `value` if the field is meant to be read-only.

rule.title: Bounded text container has cramped padding
rule.recommendation: Give text at least 8px of space inside a visible border or colored surface.

rule.title: createContext called during render
rule.recommendation: Move `createContext(...)` outside the component, to the top level of the file, so it stays the same on every render.

rule.title: Object URL is created during render
rule.recommendation: Create object URLs in an effect or event handler and revoke each URL when it is replaced or no longer needed.

rule.title: createObjectURL without revokeObjectURL
rule.recommendation: Call `URL.revokeObjectURL(url)` once the object URL is no longer needed (after the download, in a `useEffect` cleanup, or on unmount). An object URL keeps its Blob/File alive for the document lifetime until it is revoked.

rule.title: createRef in function component
rule.recommendation: Replace `createRef()` with the `useRef()` hook inside function components and hooks. `createRef` is only for class components.

rule.title: Store created during render
rule.recommendation: Create stores at module scope so subscribers are not cut off and saved state does not reset every render.

rule.title: Letter spacing compresses text excessively
rule.recommendation: Loosen the tracking until each character keeps a distinct, readable shape.

rule.title: Raw HTML injection can run unsafe markup
rule.recommendation: Render trusted content as React children so attacker-controlled HTML cannot run in users' browsers.

rule.title: dangerouslySetInnerHTML with children
rule.recommendation: Use either `children` or `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` so React does not ignore one source of content.

rule.title: Colored glow on dark background
rule.recommendation: Use a subtle `box-shadow` in neutral colors for depth, or a faint `border`. Colored glows on dark backgrounds look overdone.

rule.title: Empty blurred color orb decorates the layout
rule.recommendation: Use structure, imagery, or a restrained surface treatment instead of an oversized blurred color blob.

rule.title: Surface draws a decorative grid background
rule.recommendation: Reserve coordinate grids for data or spatial interfaces; use a quieter surface for decoration.

rule.title: Stable copy pulses for attention
rule.recommendation: Reserve pulsing motion for real in-progress feedback. Remove fake blinking cursors and use static hierarchy for decorative emphasis.

rule.title: Large decorative radial spotlight
rule.recommendation: Use product-specific imagery, structure, or a restrained solid surface instead of a large translucent radial glow.

rule.title: defaultProps removed in React 19
rule.recommendation: React 19 drops `Component.defaultProps` for function components. Set the defaults in the destructured props instead: `function Foo({ size = "md", variant = "primary" })` instead of `Foo.defaultProps = { size: "md", variant: "primary" }`.

rule.title: Page root uses a default purple-spectrum gradient
rule.recommendation: Build the page palette from the product's identity instead of a conventional purple-to-bright gradient.

rule.title: Page defaults to a warm off-white surface
rule.recommendation: Choose the page surface from an intentional product palette rather than a generic warm neutral default.

rule.title: Deprecated KeyboardEvent keyCode or which
rule.recommendation: `KeyboardEvent.keyCode`/`which`/`charCode` are deprecated and layout/engine dependent for character keys. Branch on `event.key` (logical key like `'/'`) or `event.code` (physical position) so the handler works across keyboard layouts and browsers.

rule.title: Deprecated Tailwind v4 utility
rule.recommendation: Tailwind v4 renamed these utilities: `bg-gradient-*` → `bg-linear-*`, `flex-shrink-*` → `shrink-*`, `flex-grow-*` → `grow-*`, `overflow-ellipsis` → `text-ellipsis`. Use the new names.

rule.title: Derived value copied into state
rule.recommendation: Work out the value while rendering (or with useMemo if it's expensive) instead of copying it into state and synchronizing it during render or through an effect. See https://react.dev/learn/you-might-not-need-an-effect#updating-state-based-on-props-or-state

rule.title: Derived state stored in an effect
rule.recommendation: Work out derived values while rendering: `const x = fn(dep)`. To reset a component's state when a prop changes, give it a key prop: `<Component key={prop} />`. See https://react.dev/learn/you-might-not-need-an-effect

rule.title: Prop derived into useState
rule.recommendation: Compute the value inline so prop changes do not leave `useState` holding a stale copy.

rule.title: setState in componentDidMount
rule.recommendation: Setting state in `componentDidMount` triggers an extra render. Use `getDerivedStateFromProps` or initial state instead.

rule.title: setState in componentDidUpdate
rule.recommendation: Setting state in `componentDidUpdate` causes another render and can loop. Use `getDerivedStateFromProps` instead.

rule.title: Direct mutation of this.state
rule.recommendation: Don't change `this.state` by hand. `setState()` overwrites it anyway, so always go through `setState()`.

rule.title: State mutated in place
rule.recommendation: Call the setter with a brand new value instead: `setItems([...items, newItem])`, `setItems(items.filter(x => x !== target))`, or `setItems(items.toSorted(...))`. React only redraws when the value is new, so changing it in place does nothing.

rule.title: Zoom disabled on viewport
rule.recommendation: Remove `user-scalable=no` and `maximum-scale` from the viewport meta tag. If the layout breaks at 200% zoom, fix the layout instead.

rule.title: Distracting marquee or blink element
rule.recommendation: Replace `<marquee>` and `<blink>` with normal markup so motion does not distract or disorient users.

rule.title: Direct document.startViewTransition call
rule.recommendation: Render a <ViewTransition> component and update inside startTransition or useDeferredValue, and React calls startViewTransition for you.

rule.title: document.write/writeln
rule.recommendation: Don't use `document.write()`/`document.writeln()`. Append DOM nodes or set `innerHTML`/`textContent` on a specific element instead.

rule.title: Referenced ID is duplicated
rule.recommendation: Give every statically referenced element a unique id within the rendered JSX tree.

rule.title: Non-static dynamic import path
rule.recommendation: Use a plain string path: `import('./feature/heavy.js')` so the bundler can split this into its own chunk.

rule.title: Tailwind utility is assembled dynamically
rule.recommendation: Use complete, statically discoverable Tailwind utility strings for each state instead of interpolating part of a class token.

rule.title: Eager constructor in useState initializer
rule.recommendation: Wrap nontrivial construction in a function (`useState(() => new X())`) so it only runs on the first render.

rule.title: UI motion starts with ease-in
rule.recommendation: Use ease-out for entrances and exits, or ease-in-out when an element remains visible while moving.

rule.title: Effects chained together
rule.recommendation: Compute as much as possible during render (e.g. `const isGameOver = round > 5`) and write all related state inside the event handler that originally fires the chain. Each effect link adds an extra render and makes the code rigid as requirements evolve

rule.title: Effect used as an event handler
rule.recommendation: Move event logic into the handler that starts it so the side effect does not run late after an extra render.

rule.title: Effect Event listed in effect deps
rule.recommendation: Call the useEffectEvent function inside the effect body and don't list it in the deps. It's non-reactive on purpose, so it must be omitted.

rule.title: Effect dependency recreated every render
rule.recommendation: Move the value inside the hook body and depend on its simple inputs instead, or wrap it in useMemo / useCallback so it stays the same between renders.

rule.title: Effect wrapper discards forwarded cleanup return
rule.recommendation: A custom effect wrapper must return its forwarded EffectCallback's result so React can run the cleanup. Calling it as a bare `fn()` instead of `return fn()` silently drops the cleanup, leaking every subscription/timer/listener it set up.

rule.title: Heading uses emoji as decoration
rule.recommendation: Use purposeful product artwork or a consistent icon system outside the heading instead of decorating heading copy with platform-dependent emoji.

rule.title: Empty semantic element renders as a card
rule.recommendation: Render meaningful content or remove the bordered, rounded shell until content exists.

rule.title: Enter submit without IME composition guard
rule.recommendation: Bail on IME composition before acting on Enter: `if (e.nativeEvent.isComposing) return;` (or track composition with `onCompositionStart`/`onCompositionEnd`). Otherwise Enter fires mid-composition and commits a half-typed value for CJK users.

rule.title: eval() runs untrusted code strings
rule.recommendation: Use `JSON.parse` for data, or rewrite the code so it doesn't build and run code from strings.

rule.title: Event logic handled in an effect
rule.recommendation: Run the side effect in the event handler that triggers it, instead of watching its state from a useEffect. See https://react.dev/learn/you-might-not-need-an-effect#sharing-logic-between-event-handlers

rule.title: State exists only to trigger an effect
rule.recommendation: Delete the trigger state (`useState(null)` plus the `useEffect` that watches it) and call the side effect like `post(...)`, `navigate(...)`, or `track(...)` directly in the event handler that set it. State shouldn't exist just to kick off an effect.

rule.title: Page boxes too many groups into cards
rule.recommendation: Let related content share the page surface and use spacing, dividers, or typography before adding another card boundary.

rule.title: Page centers multiple body-copy blocks
rule.recommendation: Keep longer body copy left-aligned and reserve centered text for one concise focal statement.

rule.title: Page mixes too many font families
rule.recommendation: Use a display face, a body face, and at most one purposeful outlier such as monospace.

rule.title: Motion child stagger is too long
rule.recommendation: Keep per-item stagger intervals short so later content does not feel artificially delayed.

rule.title: Page overuses pill-shaped treatments
rule.recommendation: Use pills only for controls or compact metadata whose shape communicates a real role.

rule.title: Preview redraws decorative browser chrome
rule.recommendation: Show the product screenshot directly or use a purposeful frame instead of adding imitation browser controls.

rule.title: Data fetching inside an effect
rule.recommendation: Use a data-fetching layer or Server Component so fetches do not race, double-fire, or leak from `useEffect`.

rule.title: fetch Response consumed without status check
rule.recommendation: Check `response.ok` (or `response.status`) before consuming a `fetch` Response with `.json()`/`.text()`/`.blob()`. `fetch` resolves on HTTP 4xx/5xx, so an unchecked response parses the error body as success or crashes on an always-truthy guard.

rule.title: fill().map() first param is the element, not the index
rule.recommendation: After `.fill(value)` every element is identical, so a lone `.map((n) => ...)` binds `n` to that value (whatever the parameter is named) and gives every child the same key. Add the index as the second parameter: `.map((_, index) => ...)`.

rule.title: findDOMNode breaks component encapsulation
rule.recommendation: Use a ref to reach DOM nodes because `findDOMNode` was removed in React 19 and can crash the app.

rule.title: Fixed element is scoped by a transformed ancestor
rule.recommendation: Move viewport-fixed UI outside transformed ancestors, or intentionally use absolute positioning within that containing block.

rule.title: Page typography uses a compressed size range
rule.recommendation: Use a clearer size hierarchy when a page declares several explicit typography steps.

rule.title: Floating .then in a JSX event handler
rule.recommendation: A `.then()` chain with no `.catch` in an event handler becomes an uncaught promise rejection no error boundary can catch; add a `.catch` handler (or make the handler `async` and `try/catch`).

rule.title: flushSync skips View Transitions
rule.recommendation: flushSync forces an immediate update that skips View Transitions and concurrent rendering. Use startTransition for updates that are not urgent.

rule.title: Focus waits for animation completion
rule.recommendation: Move focus when the interaction state changes, independently of visual animation completion, so canceled or reduced animations cannot delay or suppress keyboard focus.

rule.title: aria-hidden subtree contains focusable content
rule.recommendation: Remove focusable descendants from aria-hidden content, or hide and disable the whole subtree together.

rule.title: Focusable control inside role=text
rule.recommendation: Move interactive descendants outside role=text, or remove role=text so their semantics remain available.

rule.title: Full lodash import
rule.recommendation: Import just the function you need: `import debounce from 'lodash/debounce'`. Saves about 70kb.

rule.title: Hero uses a full-viewport centered template
rule.recommendation: Give the opening section a content-driven height and a composition tied to the product instead of centering a headline in an empty viewport.

rule.title: Full viewport width causes overflow
rule.recommendation: Prefer `w-full` (`width: 100%`) over `w-screen` / `100vw`. `100vw` ignores the scrollbar gutter and overflows horizontally.

rule.title: Vague event handler name
rule.recommendation: Rename it to say what it does. For example `handleSubmit` could be `saveUserProfile`, and `handleClick` could be `toggleSidebar`.

rule.title: Page uses generic marketing language
rule.recommendation: Replace broad promotional phrases with concrete capabilities, outcomes, or evidence.

rule.title: Compact icon tile uses a generic purple-to-blue gradient
rule.recommendation: Use a product color, neutral surface, or unboxed icon instead of a generic purple-to-blue gradient tile.

rule.title: Large component is hard to read and change
rule.recommendation: Pull each section into its own component so the parent is easier to read, test, and change.

rule.title: Animating a global CSS variable
rule.recommendation: Set the variable on the element that needs it instead of a parent, or use `@property` with `inherits: false`. Better yet, update `element.style.transform` directly

rule.title: Gradient text is hard to read
rule.recommendation: Use a solid text color so it stays readable. For emphasis, change the weight, size, or color instead of using a gradient.

rule.title: Gray text on colored background
rule.recommendation: Use white or near-white text, or a darker shade of the background color. Gray text on colored backgrounds looks washed out.

rule.title: Hairline border is paired with a diffuse shadow
rule.recommendation: Choose either a defined edge or soft elevation instead of emphasizing both.

rule.title: Hero uses a decorative eyebrow label
rule.recommendation: Integrate the context into the headline or navigation instead of adding a generic chip above the hero title.

rule.title: Content is revealed only on hover
rule.recommendation: Mirror hover reveals with focus or focus-within, and keep essential controls available to touch users.

rule.title: Server and client render different branches
rule.recommendation: Render the same initial output on the server and client, then switch after mount or use useSyncExternalStore with a stable server snapshot.

rule.title: Card stacks an icon tile above its heading
rule.recommendation: Place the icon beside the heading or let it sit in the content flow without another boxed surface.

rule.title: Image scales or rotates on hover
rule.recommendation: Keep the image stable, or use a subtler hover response tied to an actual interaction affordance.

rule.title: Lazy image with high fetchPriority
rule.recommendation: Don't combine `loading="lazy"` with `fetchPriority="high"`. A high-priority image (usually the LCP) should load eagerly; a lazy image is by definition not high priority.

rule.title: Image has no reserved layout space
rule.recommendation: Add width and height attributes, or reserve the image's aspect ratio with an explicit CSS box before it loads.

rule.title: Nondeterministic built-in at module scope
rule.recommendation: `Math.random()`, `Date.now()`, `performance.now()`, and `new Date()` run once at module load, so the value is frozen for the whole server process. Move the call into a function/component so it evaluates per request.

rule.title: State updater has side effects
rule.recommendation: Keep state updater callbacks pure and return only the next state. Move notifications, storage, timers, ref writes, and other external work into the event or effect that queues the update.

rule.title: Indeterminate checkbox state set as an attribute
rule.recommendation: Assign the checkbox element's `indeterminate` DOM property, usually through a ref, because the HTML attribute does not control its visual state.

rule.title: Pointer cursor has no interaction
rule.recommendation: Remove the pointer cursor or put the affordance on the control that actually handles the interaction.

rule.title: Sticky positioning has no inset
rule.recommendation: Set a non-auto inset such as top, bottom, inset-block-start, or its matching Tailwind utility on the sticky axis.

rule.title: State initialized from a mount effect
rule.recommendation: Pass the initial value directly to useState() instead of setting it from a mount-only useEffect. For SSR hydration, prefer useSyncExternalStore().

rule.title: Bouncy easing animation
rule.recommendation: Use `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` (ease-out-expo) for a natural finish. Real objects don't bounce.

rule.title: Large inline style object rebuilds every render
rule.recommendation: Move the styles to a CSS class, CSS module, Tailwind utilities, or a styled component. Big inline objects are hard to read and rebuild on every update.

rule.title: Function component defined inline inside an HOC call
rule.recommendation: Extract the inline function into a named base component at module scope and pass the reference to the HOC (`const CardBase = (props) => ...; const Card = withTracking(CardBase);`). This restores rules-of-hooks and exhaustive-deps analysis and gives the component a stable display name.

rule.title: Inline prop defeats memo()
rule.recommendation: Move the inline `() => ...` / `[]` / `{}` to a stable value with useMemo, useCallback, or module scope, so the memoized child stops redrawing on every parent render

rule.title: Interactive element given noninteractive role
rule.recommendation: Do not give an interactive element a role that says it is not interactive.

rule.title: Progress value falls outside its range
rule.recommendation: Keep determinate progress values within a valid positive range so visual and assistive feedback report the same advancement.

rule.title: Invisible native control lacks keyboard focus treatment
rule.recommendation: Reveal the native control on focus or add a visible focus-within ring to the proxy surface around it.

rule.title: isMounted lets async callbacks update after unmount
rule.recommendation: `isMounted` doesn't work in modern React. Track mount state with a ref, or cancel the async work instead.

rule.title: Display heading combines italic serif styling
rule.recommendation: Use a roman display face or reserve the italic serif treatment for a smaller editorial accent.

rule.title: JSON parse/stringify deep clone
rule.recommendation: Replace `JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value))` with `structuredClone(value)`. It is faster and preserves Dates, Maps, Sets, and cyclic references.

rule.title: No JSX.Element
rule.recommendation: Replace `JSX.Element` with `React.ReactNode`. `JSX.Element` is too narrow: it excludes `null`, strings, numbers, and fragments that components commonly return.

rule.title: Justified text without hyphens
rule.recommendation: Use `text-align: left` for body text. If you must justify, add `hyphens: auto` and `overflow-wrap: break-word`.

rule.title: Large animated blur
rule.recommendation: Keep the blur under 10px, or blur a smaller element. Big blurs use a lot more GPU memory as the element grows

rule.title: Animating a layout property
rule.recommendation: Use `transform: translateX()` or `scale()` instead. They animate smoothly without making the browser redo layout or repaint

rule.title: Interaction state changes layout geometry
rule.recommendation: Keep hover, focus, and pressed feedback to paint-only or transform properties so nearby content does not move when the state changes.

rule.title: Animating layout properties
rule.recommendation: Animate `transform` and `opacity` instead, since they're cheap for the browser. For height, animate `grid-template-rows` from `0fr` to `1fr`.

rule.title: Legacy class lifecycle methods
rule.recommendation: Move `componentWillMount` work to `componentDidMount`, `componentWillReceiveProps` to `componentDidUpdate` or the static `getDerivedStateFromProps`, and `componentWillUpdate` to `getSnapshotBeforeUpdate` plus `componentDidUpdate`. The `UNSAFE_` prefix only hides the warning. React 19 removes both.

rule.title: Legacy context API
rule.recommendation: Swap `childContextTypes` + `getChildContext` for `const MyContext = createContext(...)` and `<MyContext.Provider value={...}>`. Swap `contextTypes` for `static contextType = MyContext` or `useContext()` in a function component. Move the provider and every consumer together, or some consumers read the wrong context.

rule.title: Loading flag reset outside finally
rule.recommendation: A trailing `setLoading(false)` after an `await` never runs if the awaited call rejects, so the flag stays stuck truthy; reset it in a `finally` block (or mirror the reset on every catch) so it clears on both paths.

rule.title: Locale/timezone formatting during render
rule.recommendation: Format locale/timezone-dependent values in a post-mount useEffect + state, or pass an explicit locale and timeZone so the server and the browser render the same text. Only runs on SSR-capable projects.

rule.title: Transition duration too long
rule.recommendation: Keep UI transitions under 1s. Use about 100 to 150ms for instant feedback, 200 to 300ms for state changes, and 300 to 500ms for layout. Save longer ones for big page-load animations.

rule.title: Low-contrast text in inline style
rule.recommendation: Text needs a WCAG contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 (3:1 for large/bold text) against its background. Darken or lighten one of the colors until it passes.

rule.title: Page repeatedly uses manufactured contrast copy
rule.recommendation: State the value directly instead of repeatedly contrasting it with a vague alternative.

rule.title: Boolean prop combinations are hard to test
rule.recommendation: Split boolean-heavy APIs into smaller components or named variants so combinations stay testable.

rule.title: matchMedia in state initializer
rule.recommendation: Prefer CSS media queries for layout, or subscribe with `useSyncExternalStore` and provide a stable server snapshot.

rule.title: Prop mirrored into state via effect
rule.recommendation: Delete both the `useState` and the `useEffect` and read the prop directly while rendering. Copying a prop into state shows the old value on the first render before the effect catches up.

rule.title: CSS and Motion animate the same property
rule.recommendation: Give each property one animation owner. Remove its CSS transition when Motion controls it, or move the CSS transition to a different element or property.

rule.title: File mixes visual icon families
rule.recommendation: Use one icon family in each file so stroke, fill, and proportions agree.

rule.title: srcSet mixes width and density descriptors
rule.recommendation: Use either width descriptors with sizes or density descriptors throughout one srcSet, never both.

rule.title: Using moment.js
rule.recommendation: Switch to `import { format } from 'date-fns'` or `import dayjs from 'dayjs'` (2kb).

rule.title: Page repeats one spacing value throughout
rule.recommendation: Use deliberate spacing tiers to distinguish local groups, components, and page sections.

rule.title: Multiple components in one file
rule.recommendation: Move secondary components into their own files so each component stays easier to find, test, and change.

rule.title: View contains multiple main landmarks
rule.recommendation: Keep one visible main landmark per rendered view so assistive-technology users can jump to the primary content unambiguously.

rule.title: Repeated navigation landmarks need unique names
rule.recommendation: Give each coexisting navigation landmark a concise, unique aria-label or aria-labelledby value.

rule.title: Mutable value in effect dependencies
rule.recommendation: Read mutable values like `location.pathname` or `ref.current` inside the effect body, or subscribe with `useSyncExternalStore`. Changing them doesn't redraw the screen, so listing them in deps won't make the effect run again.

rule.title: Mutating a queried DOM node this component renders
rule.recommendation: Drive the node with state/props (or a ref for genuinely uncontrolled nodes) instead of querying it and mutating its style/class. Imperative edits to a node React renders are invisible to the virtual DOM and get reverted or clobbered on the next render.

rule.title: State mutated in place then set by same reference
rule.recommendation: Copy state before mutating it, then pass the fresh reference to the matching useState setter.

rule.title: In-place array mutation on a prop or hook result
rule.recommendation: `sort`, `reverse`, and `splice` mutate in place, so calling them on a prop or hook result corrupts shared state. Use the immutable `toSorted`/`toReversed`/`toSpliced`, or copy the array first (`[...array].sort()`) when targeting pre-ES2023 runtimes.

rule.title: Reducer mutates its state
rule.recommendation: Return a new state object from the reducer instead of changing the old one and returning it. React only notices the change when the object is new.

rule.title: Namespaced JSX element
rule.recommendation: Use a plain component or DOM tag because React cannot render JSX namespaced names like `ns:Foo`.

rule.title: Card surface is nested inside another card
rule.recommendation: Flatten the inner surface and use spacing, a divider, or typography to communicate the hierarchy.

rule.title: Component defined inside another component
rule.recommendation: Move it to module scope or a separate file so React does not recreate the component and erase its state on every parent render.

rule.title: Unguarded querySelector with href-derived selector
rule.recommendation: `querySelector`/`querySelectorAll`/`matches`/`closest` throw a `DOMException` on an invalid CSS selector, and href/hash fragments are frequently invalid. Wrap the call in try/catch or normalize the value with `CSS.escape`.

rule.title: Non-null assertion on a maybe-undefined result
rule.recommendation: Drop the `!` on `.find`/`.match`/`.get` results and handle the miss (optional chaining, a guard, or a fallback). These built-ins return `undefined`/`null` when nothing matches, so the assertion just moves the crash one line later.

rule.title: Nondeterministic id generated in render body
rule.recommendation: An id generator (uniqueId/nanoid/crypto.randomUUID/shortid) bound in the render body re-runs every render, so the id is unstable and breaks htmlFor/aria/SVG references and SSR hydration. Use useId for reference ids, or a useRef/useState initializer to mint it once.

rule.title: Handler on non-interactive element
rule.recommendation: Put interactions on a button or link, or add an interactive role.

rule.title: Noninteractive element given interactive role
rule.recommendation: Use a real interactive element instead of adding an interactive role to a static one.

rule.title: Tabindex on non-interactive element
rule.recommendation: Only add `tabIndex` to interactive elements or interactive roles.

rule.title: Textarea resizing is disabled
rule.recommendation: Let users resize multiline fields in at least the block direction unless the control grows automatically with its content.

rule.title: Nullish coalescing swallowed by adjacent arithmetic
rule.recommendation: Arithmetic binds tighter than `??`, so wrap the nullish part in parentheses (`(x ?? 0) / y`) to compute the value you actually intend.

rule.title: Styled numbers are used as section decoration
rule.recommendation: Remove decorative section numbering unless the sequence communicates real progress or ordered steps.

rule.title: Object.keys/values/entries on maybe-undefined value
rule.recommendation: `Object.keys`, `Object.values`, and `Object.entries` throw on `undefined`/`null`, so pass a `?? {}` fallback or guard the value with a null check before calling them.

rule.title: Object or lossy array coerced in a template literal
rule.recommendation: Interpolating an object or structurally nested array can produce `[object Object]` or lose structure; read a specific value or use `.join`/`JSON.stringify`.

rule.title: outline:none removes focus ring
rule.recommendation: Style `:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px }` so the focus ring shows for keyboard users but not mouse clicks.

rule.title: Hover state stacks too many effects
rule.recommendation: Use one restrained hover idea, such as a color shift or a small shadow change, instead of stacking motion, color, and depth effects.

rule.title: Long headline uses an oversized display scale
rule.recommendation: Reduce the display size for sentence-length headlines, or tighten the copy before using a hero scale.

rule.title: Text measure is too wide
rule.recommendation: Constrain long-form text to a readable line length, usually between 60ch and 75ch.

rule.title: Data passed to parent via effect
rule.recommendation: Fetch the data in the parent and pass it down as a prop (or return it from the hook), instead of handing it back up through a prop callback in a useEffect. See https://react.dev/learn/you-might-not-need-an-effect#passing-data-to-the-parent

rule.title: Live state pushed to parent via effect
rule.recommendation: Move the state up to the parent (or return it from the hook), instead of handing it back up through a prop callback in a useEffect. See https://react.dev/learn/you-might-not-need-an-effect#notifying-parent-components-about-state-changes

rule.title: Path containment check uses a string prefix
rule.recommendation: Use `path.relative(root, candidate)` and reject `..` or absolute results instead of comparing path strings with the bare root prefix.

rule.title: Permanent will-change wastes GPU
rule.recommendation: Add will-change when the animation starts (`onMouseEnter`) and remove it when it ends (`onAnimationEnd`). Leaving it on all the time wastes GPU memory and can slow things down

rule.title: Navigation count uses a pill badge
rule.recommendation: Align navigation counts as plain tabular text instead of decorating each value as a pill.

rule.title: Field relies on placeholder text for its label
rule.recommendation: Add a visible label associated with the field. Keep placeholder text for examples or formatting hints.

rule.title: Page renders a placeholder persona
rule.recommendation: Use realistic, context-specific sample content or clearly label the surface as a demo instead of shipping generic placeholder identities.

rule.title: Enabled control ignores pointer input
rule.recommendation: Remove `pointer-events: none` from enabled controls so mouse and touch users can operate them, or mark the control unavailable with native disabled semantics.

rule.title: Children type checked at runtime
rule.recommendation: Add clear subcomponents like `<Button.Text>` and `<Button.Icon>` so callers don't have to check `typeof children`.

rule.title: Predicate function used without calling it
rule.recommendation: A bare `is*`/`has*`/`can*`/`should*`/`will*` function reference is always truthy in a condition, so the guarded branch never behaves as intended. Call the function (`isReady()`) to evaluate the predicate.

rule.title: Presentational element exposes conflicting semantics
rule.recommendation: Remove the presentational role, focusability, or global ARIA state so assistive technologies receive one consistent semantic model.

rule.title: preventDefault on a form or link
rule.recommendation: Use `<form action>` where your framework supports it (it works without JS), or use a `<button>` instead of an `<a>` with preventDefault.

rule.title: Effect promise .then sets state with no catch
rule.recommendation: An async init in an effect that sets state in `.then` but has no `.catch` leaves the component stuck and raises an unhandled rejection when it fails. Add a `.catch` on the chain (`.finally` does not handle the rejection).

rule.title: Parent kept in sync with a callback effect
rule.recommendation: Move the shared state into a Provider so both sides read the same value. Then you don't need a useEffect to keep them in sync.

rule.title: Prop callback invoked during render
rule.recommendation: Invoke the callback from the event or asynchronous operation that produced the value, or from an effect when synchronizing with an external system. Render must stay pure because React can replay or discard it.

rule.title: propTypes ignored in React 19
rule.recommendation: React 19 ignores `Component.propTypes`, so invalid props pass silently. Describe props with TypeScript types and add real runtime checks (or schema parsing) only where data can actually be wrong. Only runs on React 19+ projects.

rule.title: Decorative status dot pulses continuously
rule.recommendation: Use a static status indicator unless the element communicates real work in progress.

rule.title: Pure black background
rule.recommendation: Nudge the background slightly toward your brand color, like `#0a0a0f` or Tailwind's `bg-gray-950`. Pure black looks harsh on modern screens.

rule.title: Surface uses a pure-black shadow
rule.recommendation: Tint shadows toward the surrounding surface or use a softer neutral token instead of pure black.

rule.title: Saturated radial halo on a dark surface
rule.recommendation: Use restrained surface contrast, product-specific imagery, or a subtler accent instead of a saturated radial halo on a dark page.

rule.title: Random value used as a key
rule.recommendation: Use a stable id from the item itself, like `item.id`, a content hash, or the index when the order never changes. Don't build the key from something that changes every time.

rule.title: React.Children is fragile when child shape changes
rule.recommendation: Pass children as explicit props or render them directly so child shape changes do not break traversal logic.

rule.title: Deprecated react-dom APIs break in React 19
rule.recommendation: Switch the old `react-dom` root API (`render` / `hydrate` / `unmountComponentAtNode`) to `createRoot` / `hydrateRoot` / `root.unmount()` from `react-dom/client`. Replace `findDOMNode` with a ref. `react-dom/test-utils` is gone in React 19, so use `act` from `react` and `fireEvent` / `render` from `@testing-library/react`. Only runs on React 18+ projects.

rule.title: React 19 API migration can break callers
rule.recommendation: Replace removed React APIs with their supported React 19 alternatives. Only runs on React 19+ projects.

rule.title: Reduced motion removes meaningful content
rule.recommendation: Keep the same content and actions available under reduced motion, replacing spatial movement with a static or non-spatial presentation.

rule.title: Redundant display utility
rule.recommendation: Drop the display class that matches the element's default (`block` on a `<div>`, `inline` on a `<span>`). It is pure noise; keep only display changes like `flex`, `grid`, or `hidden`.

rule.title: Redundant ARIA role
rule.recommendation: Remove redundant `role` attributes so assistive tech reads the element's native semantics without extra noise.

rule.title: Redundant shouldComponentUpdate
rule.recommendation: Drop `shouldComponentUpdate` (PureComponent already shallow-compares) or extend `React.Component` if custom logic is needed.

rule.title: Title tooltip repeats visible control text
