rule.recommendation: Remove tooltips that merely repeat a control's visible label.

rule.title: Ref cleanup requires React 19
rule.recommendation: React 18 ignores functions returned from ref callbacks. Handle cleanup when React calls the ref with `null`, or require React 19 before returning a cleanup function.

rule.title: Ref mutated during render
rule.recommendation: Move ref writes into an event handler or effect. Render must stay pure because React can replay or discard it. The predictable null-guarded lazy initialization pattern remains supported.

rule.title: Component rendered by inline function call
rule.recommendation: Make it a named component rendered as JSX so React can track it and preserve its state.

rule.title: Render-prop slots make this component hard to extend
rule.recommendation: Swap `renderXxx` props for child components like `<Modal.Header>` or plain `children`, so the parent doesn't control every slot.

rule.title: Using ReactDOM.render return value
rule.recommendation: Don't use `ReactDOM.render`'s return value. It's legacy and was removed in React 19.

rule.title: A card repeats the same text in distinct slots
rule.recommendation: Keep repeated status or label copy in the one card slot where it carries the clearest meaning.

rule.title: Page repeats boxed emoji as feature icons
rule.recommendation: Use a coherent icon set or product-specific artwork instead of repeating platform-dependent emoji tiles.

rule.title: Page repeats glass panels
rule.recommendation: Reserve translucency for one overlay or focal layer and use quieter opaque surfaces elsewhere.

rule.title: Hover scaling repeats across the page
rule.recommendation: Reserve hover movement for a specific spatial interaction instead of making unrelated cards and tiles all grow under the pointer.

rule.title: Repeated tracked labels scaffold multiple sections
rule.recommendation: Use stronger section composition or reserve the decorative kicker treatment for one meaningful moment.

rule.title: Navigation repeats placeholder destinations
rule.recommendation: Replace placeholder destinations with real routes or render non-interactive navigation previews until destinations exist.

rule.title: Page repeats the same padded section shell
rule.recommendation: Vary section composition and rhythm instead of wrapping every block in the same large padding and centered max-width container.

rule.title: Surface uses a repeating gradient texture
rule.recommendation: Use a deliberate texture asset or a quiet solid surface instead of repeating-gradient decoration.

rule.title: All state reset on prop change
rule.recommendation: Pass the prop as `key` so React resets the component for you when the prop changes, instead of clearing every state value by hand in a useEffect. See https://react.dev/learn/you-might-not-need-an-effect#resetting-all-state-when-a-prop-changes

rule.title: Responsive styles hide a control's accessible name
rule.recommendation: Keep an accessible name available at every breakpoint, such as persistent sr-only text or an aria-label on the control.

rule.title: Animating scale from zero
rule.recommendation: Use `initial={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0 }}`. Elements should gently shrink and fade, not vanish into a point

rule.title: Secret in client code
rule.recommendation: Move secrets to server-only code. Anything in client env variables gets shipped to the browser, so it can't hold secrets.

rule.title: Effect updates its own dependency
rule.recommendation: Break the loop: work the value out while rendering, set it in an event handler, or guard the update so it stops changing. See https://react.dev/learn/you-might-not-need-an-effect

rule.title: Server-side image map
rule.recommendation: Replace isMap with semantic links or a client-side map that exposes each target.

rule.title: Local class state forbidden
rule.recommendation: Lift state up or use an external store so class-local state does not hide ownership.

rule.title: State update after await in an effect
rule.recommendation: In a `useEffect` whose dependencies can change, guard any setter call that runs after an `await` behind a cancellation/ignore flag, or return a cleanup that cancels the async work.

rule.title: setState called during render
rule.recommendation: Move the setter into a `useEffect` or an event handler, or compute the value while rendering. Calling a setter during render starts another render that calls it again, looping forever.

rule.title: Large illustration is assembled from primitive shapes
rule.recommendation: Replace the shape pile with deliberate artwork, a photograph, or a purpose-built graphic that supports the product story.

rule.title: Side effect inside a state updater function
rule.recommendation: React may replay a state updater, so callbacks, analytics, and persistence inside it can run more than once. Compute state purely, then perform the side effect outside the setter.

rule.title: Thick one-sided stripe
rule.recommendation: Use a background change, a thin neutral edge, or a subtler surface treatment instead of a thick one-sided stripe.

rule.title: Heading hierarchy skips a level
rule.recommendation: Keep headings in a continuous hierarchy inside a page or article so assistive navigation reflects the visual structure.

rule.title: Form control text is smaller than 16px
rule.recommendation: Use at least 16px text on mobile inputs, selects, and textareas so content remains readable and mobile browsers do not zoom unexpectedly.

rule.title: Smooth scrolling ignores reduced motion
rule.recommendation: Enable smooth scrolling only for users without a reduced-motion preference, and fall back to instant scrolling for everyone else.

rule.title: Accumulator spread in reduce is quadratic
rule.recommendation: Mutate the accumulator and return it (`acc[key] = value; return acc`) so the fold stays O(n) instead of copying the whole accumulator every step.

rule.title: Spread props over defaults can clobber with undefined
rule.recommendation: An explicit undefined prop can overwrite a default. Reapply defaults with ?? at the merge or use site, or remove undefined keys before spreading props.

rule.title: Responsive image omits sizes
rule.recommendation: Add a sizes attribute that describes the image's rendered width at each responsive breakpoint.

rule.title: Cleared timer ref keeps the stale id
rule.recommendation: Reset the ref right after clearing (`clearTimeout(ref.current); ref.current = null`) so truthiness checks on the ref keep meaning “timer still pending”.

rule.title: Interaction on static element
rule.recommendation: Give clickable static elements a `role`, or use a button or link.

rule.title: MotionConfig always ignores reduced motion
rule.recommendation: Use `reducedMotion="user"`, or derive the value from an explicit user preference instead of permanently disabling reduced-motion support.

rule.title: String true/false on a boolean attribute
rule.recommendation: Use the boolean form on boolean attributes: `disabled` / `disabled={true}` / `disabled={false}`, not `disabled="false"`. A non-empty string is truthy, so `="false"` actually turns the attribute ON.

rule.title: String refs are legacy and fragile
rule.recommendation: Use a callback ref or `useRef` so ref ownership is explicit and not tied to legacy string lookup.

rule.title: currentColor fights a fill/stroke class
rule.recommendation: Pick one source of truth: drop the `fill="currentColor"` attribute and keep the `fill-*` class, or use `fill-current` to inherit the text color. Having both means the class silently wins.

rule.title: Text button uses symmetric padding
rule.recommendation: Give text buttons more horizontal than vertical padding to preserve their control shape.

rule.title: Synchronous XMLHttpRequest
rule.recommendation: Never open an XMLHttpRequest synchronously (`async` = `false`). It blocks the main thread. Use `fetch()` or pass `true` and handle the response asynchronously.

rule.title: Animating a layout property
rule.recommendation: Animate `transform` and `opacity` instead, since they skip layout and run on the compositor. For height, animate `grid-template-rows` from `0fr` to `1fr`.

rule.title: this used in function component
rule.recommendation: Read from the `props` argument because function components do not have a React instance `this`.

rule.title: Long all-caps heading has collision-prone leading
rule.recommendation: Use at least 1.0 line-height for an all-caps display heading that can wrap, or switch the heading to ordinary casing.

rule.title: Body copy has cramped line spacing
rule.recommendation: Use a line height of at least 1.3 for multi-line body text.

rule.title: Display heading uses the tightest tracking preset
rule.recommendation: Use normal or moderately tight tracking so display text keeps clear character shapes across fonts and viewport sizes.

rule.title: Text is too small
rule.recommendation: Use at least 12px for body text, and 16px is best. Small text is hard to read, especially on phones.

rule.title: Tiny label combines uppercase text and decorative tracking
rule.recommendation: Use ordinary interface casing at a readable size instead of shrinking and spacing out short labels.

rule.title: transition: all animates everything
rule.recommendation: List the specific properties: `transition: "opacity 200ms, transform 200ms"`. In Tailwind, use `transition-colors`, `transition-opacity`, or `transition-transform`

rule.title: Composite widget state feedback is delayed
rule.recommendation: Keep selected, checked, and current-item color feedback instant in options, menus, and trees. Reserve transitions for the widget container opening or closing.

rule.title: Focus indicator animates into view
rule.recommendation: Keep keyboard focus indicators instant. Restrict transitions to hover colors or transforms that do not delay the focus ring.

rule.title: Animation frame loop has no stop path
rule.recommendation: Add an explicit stop condition and retain each request ID so the active frame can be cancelled when the animation or component stops.

rule.title: Uncontrolled input value
rule.recommendation: Give `useState` a starting value (e.g. `useState("")` instead of `useState()`), add `onChange` (or `readOnly`) whenever you set `value`, and drop `defaultValue` on controlled inputs since React ignores it.

rule.title: Render-blocking third-party script
rule.recommendation: Use `next/script` with `strategy="lazyOnload"`, or add the `defer` attribute.

rule.title: Icon button target is smaller than 24px
rule.recommendation: Make the button at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels, or provide enough surrounding target spacing to satisfy the WCAG exception.

rule.title: Unescaped dynamic string in RegExp constructor
rule.recommendation: A dynamic literal string such as a search term or path segment dropped straight into `new RegExp(...)` lets its regex metacharacters act as operators, so values containing `.` or `(` over-match or throw. Escape the value with an `escapeRegExp` helper before constructing the pattern.

rule.title: Unescaped entities in JSX
rule.recommendation: Replace bare `'` / `"` / `>` / `}` characters with HTML entities so literal UI text is encoded consistently.

rule.title: Tailwind animation ignores reduced motion
rule.recommendation: Gate motion with motion-safe or provide a motion-reduce animation override that preserves the same information without spatial movement.

rule.title: Browser global read at module scope
rule.recommendation: Reading `window`/`navigator`/`localStorage` at module scope throws `ReferenceError: window is not defined` when the module is imported during SSR. Move the read inside a function/effect, or guard it with `typeof window !== "undefined"`.

rule.title: Browser global read during server render
rule.recommendation: Move browser-only reads into an effect or event, guard them behind a client-only render path, or use useSyncExternalStore with a stable server snapshot.

rule.title: Unguarded numeric parse of an input value
rule.recommendation: Guard `Number(e.target.value)` / `parseInt(e.target.value)` against empty and NaN before storing it. `Number('')` is `0` and `Number('abc')` is `NaN`, both of which silently ship a wrong value.

rule.title: Unguarded call to a throwing parse API
rule.recommendation: `decodeURIComponent`/`decodeURI`, color parsers (`readableColor`/`parseToRgb`/`chroma`), and single-arg `new URL(x)` on a URL/route value throw on malformed runtime input and crash render; guard with a validity pre-check (`URL.canParse`, `chroma.valid`), a try/catch, or a `safe*` helper that returns a fallback.

rule.title: Feature grid repeats one card recipe
rule.recommendation: Vary the composition, group related capabilities, or choose a denser list when every feature receives the same card weight.

rule.title: Uninformative aria-label
rule.recommendation: Name the action, not the element type: `aria-label="Search"`, not `aria-label="icon"` or `aria-label="button"`.

rule.title: Unknown DOM property
rule.recommendation: Use the prop name React expects, like `className`, `htmlFor`, or `tabIndex`, so the attribute is applied correctly.

rule.title: Stale async response clears newer request state
rule.recommendation: Guard async completion by request identity, perform an ownership-aware functional state update, or key the state-owning component by request ID.

rule.title: Unsafe legacy lifecycle method
rule.recommendation: Move setup to `constructor` or `componentDidMount`, prop-derived state to `getDerivedStateFromProps`, and update side effects to `componentDidUpdate` so React does not rely on deprecated unsafe lifecycles.

rule.title: Unsafe JSON.parse dereference
rule.recommendation: Wrap `JSON.parse(x)` in try/catch and validate the result (for example with a schema) before reading properties off it. A bare `JSON.parse(x).foo` throws on bad input and lets undefined fields slip past the type-checker.

rule.title: Component defined inside a component
rule.recommendation: Move nested components to module scope so React does not remount them and lose state on every render.

rule.title: Scroll handler drives animation every event
rule.recommendation: Use a scroll or view timeline, IntersectionObserver, or a real timer throttle so animation work does not run for every scroll event.

rule.title: Short label uses uppercase monospace styling
rule.recommendation: Use the interface typeface and ordinary casing for labels; reserve monospace for values that are genuinely code-like.

rule.title: Navigation label uses uppercase tracking
rule.recommendation: Use ordinary casing and tracking for persistent navigation labels.

rule.title: useMemo on a cheap value
rule.recommendation: Remove the useMemo. Property reads, math, and ternaries are already fast, so wrapping them doesn't help

rule.title: Whole-object param default loses per-key defaults
rule.recommendation: A whole-object parameter default applies only when the argument is omitted entirely, so a partial argument makes every omitted key undefined. Move each fallback onto its own binding instead: `({ a = 1, b = false } = {})`.

rule.title: Whole props object in deps while only members are read
rule.recommendation: Destructure the fields you read and depend on those bindings instead of the whole props object.

rule.title: Wide letter spacing on body text
rule.recommendation: Save wide letter-spacing (over 0.05em) for short uppercase labels, nav items, and buttons, not body text.

rule.title: setState in componentWillUpdate
rule.recommendation: Avoid setState in componentWillUpdate because it can loop forever; derive state before render or move guarded updates to componentDidUpdate.

rule.title: Excessively high z-index
rule.recommendation: Pick a small z-index scale, like dropdown 10, modal 20, toast 30. To layer something on top, use `isolation: isolate` instead of bigger numbers.

rule.title: NoSQL query accepts operator-shaped input
rule.recommendation: Coerce scalar fields before querying, reject operator keys from client input, and avoid `$where` or request-derived regexes.

rule.title: Non-component export in component file
rule.recommendation: Move non-component exports out of component files so Fast Refresh can preserve component state instead of full-reloading.

rule.title: Secret-like package metadata
rule.recommendation: Keep secrets out of package metadata and generated reports; they are often published to registries, logs, or browser artifacts.

rule.title: Filesystem path uses caller input
rule.recommendation: Resolve paths against a fixed base directory, reject traversal after normalization, and map user-visible identifiers to server-owned paths.

rule.title: Plugin or updater trust boundary risk
rule.recommendation: Require signed updates/plugins, pin trusted repositories, verify hashes before execution, and keep custom repository installs behind explicit warnings.

rule.title: Captured pointer interaction has no cancellation path
rule.recommendation: Handle `onPointerCancel` or `onLostPointerCapture` with the same cleanup used for pointer-up so interrupted drags cannot stay active.

rule.title: postMessage handler without origin check
rule.recommendation: Validate `event.origin` against an exact allowlist before using `event.data`, especially when an iframe or parent window can be attacker-controlled.

rule.title: Array methods on Preact children can crash
rule.recommendation: Wrap with `toChildArray(children)` because Preact's `props.children` is not always an array and array methods can crash.

rule.title: React hook imports break pure Preact hook state
rule.recommendation: Import hooks from `preact/hooks` so they share Preact's renderer state instead of loading a second hook implementation.

rule.title: render() reads props from arguments
rule.recommendation: Read from `this.props` and `this.state` because `preact/compat` uses React's parameterless `render()` and positional props/state become undefined.

rule.title: onDoubleClick instead of onDblClick
rule.recommendation: Rename `onDoubleClick` to `onDblClick` because Preact core listens for the DOM `dblclick` event name and `onDoubleClick` never fires.

rule.title: onChange instead of onInput
rule.recommendation: Replace `onChange` with `onInput` on text-like inputs, or use `preact/compat` which remaps `onChange` automatically.

rule.title: Use dvh instead of vh for full height
rule.recommendation: Prefer `dvh` over `vh` for full-height elements. `100vh` overflows under mobile browser chrome; `100dvh` tracks the visible viewport. (`h-dvh`/`min-h-dvh` need Tailwind 3.4+.)

rule.title: Heavy library loaded eagerly
rule.recommendation: Load it only when needed: `const Component = dynamic(() => import('library'), { ssr: false })` from next/dynamic, or React.lazy().

rule.title: createClass instead of ES6 class
rule.recommendation: Pick one component style so readers do not have to switch between legacy `createReactClass` patterns and modern class components.

rule.title: Prefer explicit variant components
rule.recommendation: Replace boolean props that switch whole subtrees with explicit variant components, like `<ThreadComposer />` and `<EditMessageComposer />`, so each variant renders one clear path.

rule.title: Class component instead of function
rule.recommendation: Rewrite the class component as a function component so state and effects use modern hook patterns instead of class lifecycles.

rule.title: Custom modal instead of dialog
rule.recommendation: Replace the wrapper with `<dialog>` and open it with `dialog.showModal()`. For the trigger, prefer `<button commandfor="id" command="show-modal">` (Chrome 135+), or a `useRef` with `dialogRef.current?.showModal()`.

rule.title: Pure function rebuilt every render
rule.recommendation: Move the function above the component, at the top of the file. It doesn't use local state, so rebuilding it each update is wasted work.

rule.title: Static value rebuilt every render
rule.recommendation: Move the value above the component, at the top of the file. It doesn't use local state, so rebuilding it each update is wasted and makes it look new every time.

rule.title: Motion individual transforms miss compositor acceleration
rule.recommendation: For animation that must remain smooth while JavaScript is busy, animate one `transform` string instead of Motion's individual transform keys.

rule.title: Empty fallback rebuilt each render
rule.recommendation: Make a `const EMPTY = []` (or `{}`) at module scope and use it as the `||` / `??` fallback, so the value stays the same each render.

rule.title: Changing table numbers use proportional figures
rule.recommendation: Apply `tabular-nums` to dynamic numeric columns so digits keep a stable width and align while values change.

rule.title: Role used instead of HTML tag
rule.recommendation: Use the matching HTML element when one exists so browsers and assistive tech get native semantics.

rule.title: Use truncate shorthand
rule.recommendation: Replace `overflow-hidden text-ellipsis whitespace-nowrap` with the single Tailwind `truncate` utility, which sets all three.

rule.title: Effect re-subscribes on a changing callback
rule.recommendation: Wrap the callback with `useEffectEvent(callback)` (React 19.2+) and call it inside the sub-handler. An Effect Event always sees the latest props and state but isn't a dependency, so the effect won't re-subscribe every time the parent redraws. See https://react.dev/reference/react/useEffectEvent

rule.title: Hand-rolled external store subscription
rule.recommendation: Replace the `useState(getSnapshot())` + `useEffect(() => store.subscribe(() => setSnapshot(getSnapshot())))` pair with `useSyncExternalStore(store.subscribe, getSnapshot)`. The hook gets this right during concurrent rendering and on the server; the hand-rolled version doesn't.

rule.title: Many related useState calls
rule.recommendation: Group state that always changes together into `useReducer` so one dispatched action describes the whole transition instead of a list of setter calls.

rule.title: Public debug artifact
rule.recommendation: Remove debug artifacts from public output; logs and dumps often reveal source paths, internal routes, tokens, or environment snapshots.

rule.title: Secret-like public env variable
rule.recommendation: Public env prefixes are inlined into browser bundles. Rename public values to non-secret names, and keep tokens, passwords, private keys, and service-role credentials server-only.

rule.title: Spreading a whole query result subscribes to every field
rule.recommendation: TanStack Query only subscribes to the fields you actually read, so `query.data` is as targeted as destructuring. Spreading the whole result reads every field and re-renders on each change; pick out only the fields you need.

rule.title: Floating mutateAsync rejection
rule.recommendation: Await, return, or handle rejection from the `mutateAsync()` promise so a failed mutation cannot become an unhandled rejection.

rule.title: Mutation without cache invalidation
rule.recommendation: Add `onSuccess: () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['...'] })` so cached data stays in sync after the mutation

rule.title: Mutation driven from an effect as a read
rule.recommendation: Use `useQuery` with a `queryKey` and `enabled` for reads started by an effect so the result is cached and deduplicated.

rule.title: Query refetch inside useEffect
rule.recommendation: Use `queryKey` changes or `enabled` so React Query schedules the fetch once instead of refetching again from `useEffect`.

rule.title: Rest destructuring on query result
rule.recommendation: Destructure only the fields you need, like `const { data, isLoading } = useQuery(...)`. Rest destructuring subscribes to every field and adds re-renders.

rule.title: useQuery used for mutation
rule.recommendation: Use `useMutation()` for POST/PUT/DELETE. It gives onSuccess/onError callbacks, doesn't auto-refetch, and models writes correctly.

rule.title: queryFn returns no value
rule.recommendation: queryFn must return a value for the cache. Use the `enabled` option to conditionally disable the query instead of returning undefined

rule.title: Unstable QueryClient in component
rule.recommendation: Move `new QueryClient()` to module scope, or wrap it in `useState(() => new QueryClient())`. Recreating it each render wipes the cache.

rule.title: Unbounded device pixel ratio
rule.recommendation: Cap devicePixelRatio, commonly at 2, or pass an explicit DPR range so high-density displays do not multiply rendering work without a bound

rule.title: Too many shadow-casting point lights
rule.recommendation: Keep at most two shadow-casting point lights in one scene, or replace them with cheaper directional, spot, baked, or fake shadows

rule.title: Clock advanced inside useFrame
rule.recommendation: Use the delta argument supplied to useFrame or read clock.elapsedTime without advancing the shared clock

rule.title: Allocation inside an R3F pointer-move handler
rule.recommendation: Reuse component-owned vectors and Three.js objects while handling pointer movement

rule.title: Async useFrame callback
rule.recommendation: Keep useFrame synchronous; start asynchronous work outside the render loop and consume its completed state from the callback

rule.title: Three.js clone inside useFrame
rule.recommendation: Clone once outside the frame loop or reuse a scratch vector, quaternion, matrix, or object allocated with useMemo or useRef

rule.title: useThree selector reads a mutable Three.js field
rule.recommendation: Select the stable R3F store object, then read its mutable Three.js fields where they are consumed

rule.title: Disposal of a cached R3F loader asset
rule.recommendation: Do not dispose assets returned by cached R3F and Drei loader hooks

rule.title: Primitive object mounted twice
rule.recommendation: Mount a Three.js object through one <primitive>, or clone it deliberately when two independent instances are required

rule.title: R3F catalogue extension during render
rule.recommendation: Call extend at module scope so React renders and Strict Mode replays do not repeatedly mutate R3F's global catalogue

rule.title: Whole Three.js namespace registered with R3F
rule.recommendation: Pass extend an object containing only the Three.js constructors used by JSX so bundlers can tree-shake the rest of the namespace

rule.title: Fresh R3F portal container
rule.recommendation: Keep the createPortal container stable with module scope, lazy state, or useMemo so R3F can preserve the portal store and event layer

rule.title: Fresh useThree selector result
rule.recommendation: Select one stable store field at a time, or provide an equality function when returning an object or array from useThree

rule.title: Imperative attachment of an R3F-managed ref
rule.recommendation: Let R3F attach objects referenced by JSX. Do not add or attach the same ref.current imperatively

rule.title: Inline primitive object
rule.recommendation: Create or clone the Three.js object once outside render, or memoize it, before passing it to <primitive>

rule.title: Inline R3F resource prop
rule.recommendation: Create the Three.js geometry or material once at module scope, in lazy state, or with useMemo before passing it as an R3F resource prop

rule.title: Private R3F import
rule.recommendation: Import from @react-three/fiber or one of its documented public entry points instead of a dist or src implementation path

rule.title: Manual resize loop for an R3F-owned renderer
rule.recommendation: Let Canvas and its ResizeObserver own renderer sizing instead of registering a window resize loop

rule.title: Mutation of a cached R3F loader asset
rule.recommendation: Clone the loaded object or resource before mutating it

rule.title: Mutation of shared R3F pointer-event data
rule.recommendation: Copy shared pointer-event vectors before applying local-space transforms or other mutations

rule.title: Allocation inside useFrame
rule.recommendation: Allocate Three.js objects once in module scope, useMemo, or useRef and mutate the reusable instance inside useFrame

rule.title: Nullish R3F loader input
rule.recommendation: Conditionally render a child component that calls the loader hook only after it has a real asset URL

rule.title: Pointer capture called on an R3F scene object
rule.recommendation: Call pointer-capture methods on the R3F event target or currentTarget, not object or eventObject

rule.title: Competing animation loop alongside useFrame
rule.recommendation: Use R3F's useFrame subscription as the component's single animation loop instead of starting a second browser or renderer loop

rule.title: React state update inside an R3F pointer-move handler
rule.recommendation: Keep pointer-move previews in Three.js refs or transient state and publish one semantic React update when the interaction commits

rule.title: React state update inside useFrame
rule.recommendation: Mutate Three.js refs or an external transient store inside useFrame; reserve React state for guarded, infrequent transitions

rule.title: Synchronous readback inside useFrame
rule.recommendation: Move readback to a discrete or serialized async path and reuse the latest completed result during frames

rule.title: Unstable R3F constructor args
rule.recommendation: Keep reference-valued constructor arguments stable with module scope or useMemo so React Three Fiber does not reconstruct and dispose the Three.js object on a later render

rule.title: Dependency array passed to useFrame
rule.recommendation: Remove the dependency array. Pass a numeric render priority on R3F v9, or supported scheduling options on R3F v10

rule.title: Repeated R3F meshes use separate draw calls
rule.recommendation: Render repeated meshes that share geometry and material with <instancedMesh> so they can use one draw call

rule.title: Imperative Three.js loader in a React effect
rule.recommendation: Load render resources with R3F useLoader so Suspense caching can share and deduplicate them

rule.title: Frame-rate-dependent animation
rule.recommendation: Scale incremental transforms and interpolation by useFrame delta, use delta-aware damping, or assign from absolute time

rule.title: Unreleased global R3F render-loop effect
rule.recommendation: Register addEffect, addAfterEffect, and addTail from an effect and return the exact disposer so remounts do not retain global render-loop callbacks

rule.title: Instanced mesh buffer is not marked for upload
rule.recommendation: After setMatrixAt or setColorAt, set the matching instance buffer's needsUpdate flag to true

rule.title: Locally owned Three.js texture is not disposed
rule.recommendation: Dispose locally constructed textures in a React effect cleanup

rule.title: Missing camera projection-matrix update
rule.recommendation: Call camera.updateProjectionMatrix() after imperatively changing projection properties so Three.js renders the new frustum

rule.title: Positive useFrame priority without a render
rule.recommendation: Render the scene or composer from the positive-priority useFrame subscription, or use a non-positive priority to keep automatic rendering enabled

rule.title: R3F root without unmount cleanup
rule.recommendation: Unmount component-owned R3F roots in React cleanup, or return an exact disposer that unmounts the root

rule.title: Incompatible R3F Canvas renderer prop
rule.recommendation: Use renderer with @react-three/fiber/webgpu, gl with /legacy, and never pass both renderer APIs to one Canvas

rule.title: WebGPU root reads deprecated gl state
rule.recommendation: Read state.renderer from the R3F WebGPU root instead of state.gl

rule.title: JavaScript branch reads a TSL uniform value
rule.recommendation: Express uniform-dependent control flow with TSL If, select, or Loop nodes so it runs on the GPU

rule.title: Legacy EffectComposer inside an R3F WebGPU Canvas
rule.recommendation: Use the renderer's node-based post-processing pipeline instead of @react-three/postprocessing EffectComposer

rule.title: Legacy shader material API inside an R3F WebGPU Canvas
rule.recommendation: Use Three.js node materials and TSL for custom shaders rendered by the WebGPU backend

rule.title: Unregistered WebGPU pipeline pass
rule.recommendation: Return custom passes from the WebGPU post-processing callback so R3F registers them in state.passes

rule.title: Radio input missing name
rule.recommendation: Give every radio in the same group the same `name` prop (e.g. `<input type="radio" name="shippingSpeed" />`). The browser groups radios and enables arrow-key navigation only when they share a `name`.

rule.title: Raw SQL built outside parameter binding
rule.recommendation: Keep user input in driver parameters or ORM bind variables. Avoid unsafe/raw SQL helpers and string interpolation for queries.

rule.title: Manual memoization in compiler-managed code
rule.recommendation: Profile compiler-managed code and remove `useMemo`, `useCallback`, or `memo` only when the manual cache no longer carries behavioral or performance intent.

rule.title: React not in scope for JSX
rule.recommendation: If you're on React 17+ with the new JSX transform, disable this rule. Otherwise import `React` at the top of the file.

rule.title: Unsanitized raw HTML in React Markdown
rule.recommendation: Add `rehype-sanitize` to `rehypePlugins` or sanitize dynamic markdown before rendering. `skipHtml` does not disable HTML already parsed by `rehype-raw`.

rule.title: CSP nonce is not shared across server rendering
rule.recommendation: Pass the same request-scoped nonce to ServerRouter and the React server-rendering stream options.

rule.title: Parent path cannot match descendant routes
rule.recommendation: End the mounting route path with /* so its descendant Routes tree can match deeper URLs.

rule.title: Aborted requests are reported as errors
rule.recommendation: Return early when request.signal.aborted before reporting the error from handleError.

rule.title: Internal route uses a document navigation
rule.recommendation: Use React Router Link for navigation to a known UI route.

rule.title: Loader fetch ignores cancellation
rule.recommendation: Pass request.signal to fetch so superseded navigations cancel work that no longer contributes to the route.

rule.title: Independent loader work runs sequentially
rule.recommendation: Start independent loader work together with Promise.all to avoid adding serial latency to navigation.

rule.title: Nested routes have no Outlet
rule.recommendation: Render <Outlet /> from the parent route component where child routes belong.

rule.title: Middleware catch cannot observe downstream errors
rule.recommendation: Use an ErrorBoundary, handleError, or middleware response instrumentation instead of catching next().

rule.title: Client-only module rendered on the server
rule.recommendation: Move client-only behavior behind a hydration boundary instead of importing a .client module into server-rendered JSX.

rule.title: Duplicate route ID
rule.recommendation: Give every explicit route ID a unique value within the router.

rule.title: Leaf route renders nothing
rule.recommendation: Add element, Component, or lazy to a UI leaf route, or remove the empty route.

rule.title: Absolute child path escapes its parent
rule.recommendation: Make the child path relative, or prefix its absolute path with the complete parent route path.

rule.title: Immutable route property returned from lazy
rule.recommendation: Keep route-matching properties on the static route object; lazy may return only non-matching route properties.

rule.title: Invalid splat route path
rule.recommendation: Use '*' for a catch-all route or end a path with '/*'.

rule.title: Loader reads a request body
rule.recommendation: Read submitted request bodies in an action; loaders handle GET requests and should use URL search parameters instead.

rule.title: Middleware consumes the outgoing response body
rule.recommendation: Inspect or change response headers and status without consuming the body returned by next().

rule.title: Multiple blockers in one component
rule.recommendation: Combine blocking conditions into one useBlocker call per rendered component.

rule.title: Middleware continuation called twice
rule.recommendation: Call next exactly once and reuse the returned Response.

rule.title: Search params updated multiple times
rule.recommendation: Combine changes into one setSearchParams call because updates in the same tick do not queue like React state.

rule.title: navigate() called during render
rule.recommendation: Render <Navigate> for declarative redirects, redirect from a loader or action, or navigate from an event or effect.

rule.title: Router nested inside another router
rule.recommendation: Keep one router provider at the application root.

rule.title: redirect() inside try-catch
rule.recommendation: Move redirect outside the guarded try block or rethrow redirect responses from catch.

rule.title: Route module has an environment suffix
rule.recommendation: Keep the route module environment-neutral and move environment-specific code into imported .client or .server modules.

rule.title: Router created during render
rule.recommendation: Create the router at module scope so navigation state and subscriptions survive renders.

rule.title: Loader mutates session state
rule.recommendation: Mutate and commit sessions in an action, then redirect to a loader.

rule.title: Cookie expiry is fixed at module load
rule.recommendation: Use maxAge for a duration-based cookie lifetime.

rule.title: Search params mutated without navigation
rule.recommendation: Clone the URLSearchParams value, mutate the clone, and return or pass it to setSearchParams.

rule.title: Error UI assumes loader data exists
rule.recommendation: Use useRouteLoaderData with an explicit route ID and handle undefined inside error UI.

rule.title: React.lazy creates a route-module waterfall
rule.recommendation: Load route modules with the route lazy property so initial navigation does not download every route component.

rule.title: Root route lacks an error boundary
rule.recommendation: Define ErrorBoundary or errorElement on the root route so rendering, loader, and action failures have an application fallback.

rule.title: Resource link intercepted as navigation
rule.recommendation: Add reloadDocument to resource links so the browser downloads or opens the resource instead of client-routing it.

rule.title: Transition drops a navigation promise
rule.recommendation: Return or await the navigation promise from the transition callback so pending state lasts through navigation.

rule.title: Server middleware drops the Response
rule.recommendation: Return the Response produced by next(), or return an explicit replacement Response.

rule.title: Session mutation is not committed
rule.recommendation: Serialize the session with commitSession or destroySession and include its Set-Cookie value in the returned Response.

rule.title: Removed meta data field
rule.recommendation: Read loaderData instead of the removed data field.

rule.title: Removed react-router-dom import
rule.recommendation: Import DOM-only APIs from react-router/dom and all other APIs from react-router.

rule.title: Removed React Router future flag
rule.recommendation: Remove v8 future flags; move v8_splitRouteModules to the top-level splitRouteModules option.

rule.title: Contradictory route object
rule.recommendation: Remove incompatible route properties so each route has one unambiguous rendering contract.

rule.title: useSelector derives data inline
rule.recommendation: Select the raw slice and memoize derivation so Redux actions do not rebuild a collection and redraw this component.

rule.title: useSelector returns a new collection
rule.recommendation: Return a stable selected value, split selectors, or pass `shallowEqual` so every Redux action does not redraw this component.

rule.title: calculateMetadata fetch ignores abortSignal
rule.recommendation: Destructure `abortSignal` from the calculateMetadata argument and pass it to direct fetch calls as `{signal: abortSignal}`.

rule.title: Randomness changes between rendered frames
rule.recommendation: Use Remotion's seeded `random(seed)` helper so the same frame produces the same value in every render tab.

rule.title: CSS animation is not frame-driven
rule.recommendation: Drive the property from `useCurrentFrame()` with `interpolate()` so every rendered frame is deterministic.

rule.title: CSS transition is not frame-driven
rule.recommendation: Drive the property from `useCurrentFrame()` with `interpolate()` so every rendered frame is deterministic.

rule.title: CSS URL asset can flicker in Remotion
rule.recommendation: Render the asset with `Img` inside an `AbsoluteFill`, or preload the same source with a hidden `Img` when a CSS mask is required.

rule.title: Module-scoped delayRender blocks every composition
rule.recommendation: Create the handle once inside the component. Use `useDelayRender()` on Remotion 4.0.342 or newer, or lazy `useState(() => delayRender())` on earlier versions.

rule.title: Native media element bypasses Remotion loading
rule.recommendation: Use Remotion's media components so rendering waits for assets and seeks media to the requested frame.

rule.title: Next.js Image can flicker in Remotion
rule.recommendation: Use `Img` from `remotion`, which delays rendering until the image is loaded.

rule.title: delayRender handle is recreated during render
rule.recommendation: Prefer `useDelayRender()`, or initialize `delayRender()` once with `useState(() => delayRender())`.

rule.title: Animating an SVG directly
rule.recommendation: Wrap the SVG in a motion element so animation props apply to a stable wrapper instead of the SVG node itself.

rule.title: Number before && renders stray 0
rule.recommendation: Use `{items.length > 0 && <List />}`, or a ternary like `{items.length ? <List /> : null}`.

rule.title: Constant JSX rebuilt each render
rule.recommendation: Move the static JSX out to the top of the file: `const ICON = <svg>...</svg>`, so it isn't rebuilt on every render

rule.title: Time or random value in JSX
rule.recommendation: Move time or random values into useEffect+useState so they only run in the browser, or add suppressHydrationWarning to the parent if it's intentional

rule.title: useEffect setState flashes on mount
rule.recommendation: Initialize state from a render-safe value before the first paint, or read external mutable values with `useSyncExternalStore`.

rule.title: Script without defer or async
rule.recommendation: Add `defer` for scripts that need the page, or `async` for standalone ones like analytics. In Next.js, use `<Script strategy="afterInteractive" />`

rule.title: Overly precise SVG path values
rule.recommendation: Round path, points, and transform decimals to 1 or 2 digits. The extra precision adds bytes with no visible difference.

rule.title: Loading useState forces extra render
rule.recommendation: Replace with `const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition()`, which marks the update as non-urgent and interruptible so the input stays responsive

rule.title: Secret file checked into repository
rule.recommendation: Remove committed env files, service-account credentials, npm auth tokens, and webhook URLs; rotate exposed values and keep only redacted examples in source.

rule.title: Request input spread without field allowlist
rule.recommendation: Assign explicit, allowlisted fields (or validate with a strict schema and no `.passthrough()`) instead of spreading/merging request input. Otherwise the client can set ownership, role, or price columns (mass assignment) or pollute the prototype.

rule.title: Autoplay video has no poster frame
rule.recommendation: Provide a representative `poster` image so the video region is intentional before playback begins and while media is unavailable.

rule.title: Render method does not return
rule.recommendation: Return JSX or `null` from `render` so the component intentionally shows something or nothing.

rule.title: Scaled menu omits its transform origin
rule.recommendation: Anchor scaled menus and listboxes to the edge nearest their trigger.

rule.title: URL hook value only read in handlers
rule.recommendation: Read the URL inside the handler (e.g. `new URL(window.location.href).searchParams`) so the component doesn't redraw every time the URL changes.

rule.title: Unstable value recreated every render
rule.recommendation: Move it into a useMemo, useRef, or a constant outside the component so it stays the same between renders.

rule.title: Continuous hook value over-renders
rule.recommendation: Use a threshold hook like `useMediaQuery("(max-width: 767px)")`, so the screen only redraws when the answer changes, not on every pixel

rule.title: setState reads a stale value
rule.recommendation: Use the callback form: `setState(prev => prev + 1)` to always read the latest value

rule.title: Ref initializer runs on every render
rule.recommendation: Initialize the ref lazily so expensive values are not rebuilt and discarded on every render.

rule.title: State initializer runs on every render
rule.recommendation: Wrap expensive initial state in an arrow function so the initializer does not rerun and get thrown away on every render.

rule.title: useMemo before an early return
rule.recommendation: Move the JSX into a child component rendered after the early return, so renders that take the early return never build it

rule.title: Empty default prop breaks memo
rule.recommendation: Move it to the top of the file: `const EMPTY_ITEMS: Item[] = []`, then use that as the default value

rule.title: State only used in handlers
rule.recommendation: Use useRef instead of useState when the value is only set and never shown on screen. `ref.current = ...` updates it without redrawing the component.

rule.title: setState in a scroll handler
rule.recommendation: Wrap the setState in startTransition, use useDeferredValue, or keep the value in a ref and throttle with requestAnimationFrame, so these events don't redraw the screen every time

rule.title: Animating a layout property
rule.recommendation: Retired: Reanimated `useAnimatedStyle` can safely drive layout-affecting properties on the UI thread, so this pattern should not be flagged.

rule.title: useAnimatedReaction just copies a value
rule.recommendation: This useAnimatedReaction just copies one value to another. Replace it with `useDerivedValue(() => ..., [deps])`, which is shorter and tracks changes for you.

rule.title: Ignored BottomSheetScrollView prop
rule.recommendation: Remove scrollEventThrottle, decelerationRate, and onScrollBeginDrag from BottomSheetScrollView because the component ignores them.

rule.title: React state update in Bottom Sheet onAnimate
rule.recommendation: Avoid starting React renders from onAnimate. Use animatedIndex or animatedPosition for animation-coupled UI, or onChange for committed index state.

rule.title: JS bottom sheet misses native sheet behavior
rule.recommendation: When native presentation fits the design, use `<Modal presentationStyle="formSheet">` for platform-native gestures, accessibility, and presentation behavior.

rule.title: React Native scrollable inside a Bottom Sheet
rule.recommendation: Use @gorhom/bottom-sheet's integrated BottomSheetScrollView, BottomSheetFlatList, BottomSheetSectionList, or BottomSheetVirtualizedList so gestures coordinate with the sheet.

rule.title: Un-awaited Detox action
rule.recommendation: Prepend `await` to Detox actions, `waitFor(...)` chains, and `expect(element(...))` assertions. They return promises tied to Detox's synchronization, so a missing await runs steps out of order.

rule.title: Inline handler in list renderItem
rule.recommendation: Move the handler out with useCallback at list scope and pass the row id as a prop. Then memo() rows skip redrawing when their data has not changed.

rule.title: List data rebuilt every render
rule.recommendation: This builds a new array each time the parent redraws, so every row redraws too. Wrap it in `useMemo(() => items.map(...), [items])` to keep the same array.

rule.title: List missing estimatedItemSize
rule.recommendation: Without `estimatedItemSize` the list guesses row height and can flash blank cells on fast scroll. Add `estimatedItemSize={<avg-row-height-in-px>}` so it matches your rows.

rule.title: Recyclable list missing getItemType
rule.recommendation: When rows have different shapes, reused cells can show the wrong layout. Add `getItemType` that returns a stable type for each row shape so FlashList keeps separate recycling pools.

rule.title: Deep import into react-native internals
rule.recommendation: Import the symbol from `react-native` (the package root) instead of the deprecated `react-native/Libraries/...` subpath, which RFC 0894 removes on upgrade.

rule.title: Module removed from react-native core
rule.recommendation: These modules were removed from react-native core. Import them from the community package instead.

rule.title: Dimensions.get over useWindowDimensions
rule.recommendation: Use `const { width, height } = useWindowDimensions()` so the size updates automatically on rotation and resize.

rule.title: Numeric && renders bare zero
rule.recommendation: When the number is 0, this shows a bare `0` as text, which crashes on RN. Use `{value > 0 && <X />}`, `{Boolean(value) && <X />}`, or `{value ? <X /> : null}`.

rule.title: Children inside react-native <Image>
rule.recommendation: React Native's `<Image>` can't render children. Use `<ImageBackground>` (same `source`/`style` props) to layer content over an image.

rule.title: Inline renderItem on list
rule.recommendation: Move renderItem to a named function or wrap it in useCallback so it is not rebuilt every time the screen redraws.

rule.title: Inline object in list renderItem
rule.recommendation: Move style and object props out of renderItem (StyleSheet.create, useMemo at list scope, or pass primitives) so memo() rows stop redrawing when their data has not changed.

rule.title: Unmaintained legacy Expo package
rule.recommendation: Switch to the maintained replacement package so users are not stuck with unfixed bugs in deprecated Expo packages.

rule.title: Legacy platform-specific shadow styles
rule.recommendation: Use `boxShadow` for shadows that work on both platforms on the new architecture, instead of platform-specific shadow properties.

rule.title: Non-native JS navigator
rule.recommendation: Use `@react-navigation/native-stack` for stack navigation. Treat drawers separately because standalone React Navigation has no native drawer replacement.

rule.title: PanResponder over react-native-gesture-handler
rule.recommendation: Use `react-native-gesture-handler` (`Gesture.Pan()`) instead of `PanResponder`. It runs gestures on the native UI thread, so they stay smooth even when the JS thread is busy.

rule.title: Raw text outside a Text component
rule.recommendation: Text outside a `<Text>` component crashes on React Native. Wrap it like `<Text>{value}</Text>`.

rule.title: renderItem key is ignored by React Native lists
rule.recommendation: A `key` on the JSX from renderItem does nothing, since lists get row keys from `keyExtractor` (or `item.key`). Remove it and set `keyExtractor` on the list instead.

rule.title: setState in onScroll handler
rule.recommendation: `setState` on every scroll event redraws the screen dozens of times a second. Track the position with a Reanimated shared value (`useAnimatedScrollHandler`) or a ref.

rule.title: Non-virtualized mapped list in ScrollView
rule.recommendation: `<ScrollView>{items.map(...)}</ScrollView>` builds every row at once, which slows scrolling. Use FlashList, LegendList, or FlatList instead.

rule.title: Imperative setNativeProps (no-op under Fabric)
rule.recommendation: Drive the prop through React state, an `Animated.Value` (with `useNativeDriver: true`), or a Reanimated shared value. `setNativeProps` is a silent no-op under the New Architecture.

rule.title: Single-element style array adds wasted allocation
rule.recommendation: Use `style={value}` instead of `style={[value]}`. A one-item array just adds extra work for nothing.

rule.title: Platform reached through React Native namespace
rule.recommendation: Import `Platform` directly with `import { Platform } from "react-native"` so Expo can remove code for the other platform.

rule.title: Manual safe-area insets can duplicate offsets
rule.recommendation: Retired: SafeAreaView wrappers are valid; prefer native content inset adjustment only when manual inset plumbing causes scroll jumps or duplicated safe-area offsets.

rule.title: react-native Image instead of expo-image
rule.recommendation: Use `<Image>` from `expo-image` instead of `react-native`. Same props, plus caching, placeholders, and crossfades for faster image loading.

rule.title: Touchable components instead of Pressable
rule.recommendation: Use `<Pressable>` because Touchable* components are frozen and lack Pressable's state-based feedback and accessibility behavior.

rule.title: GestureDetector for a plain tap
rule.recommendation: Every GestureDetector sets up a native handler when it appears, which slows the screen. For a plain tap, use `<Pressable>` (or `createCSSAnimatedComponent(Pressable)` from react-native-reanimated/css for animated press feedback).

rule.title: JS-thread animation instead of Reanimated
rule.recommendation: Use `import Animated from 'react-native-reanimated'` so animations run on the UI thread instead of the JS thread, which keeps them smooth.

rule.title: Pressable animates on the JS thread
rule.recommendation: This press animation runs on the JS thread, so it can stutter. Wrap it in <GestureDetector gesture={Gesture.Tap()...}> to run it on the UI thread.

rule.title: Legacy Reanimated spring threshold
rule.recommendation: Replace Reanimated 3 rest thresholds with Reanimated 4's `energyThreshold` spring option.

rule.title: API removed in Reanimated 4
rule.recommendation: Migrate removed Reanimated APIs to their Reanimated 4 or Gesture API replacements before upgrading.

rule.title: Scheduler moved to Worklets
rule.recommendation: Import the corresponding scheduler from `react-native-worklets` when migrating to Reanimated 4.

rule.title: Dynamic padding on contentContainerStyle
rule.recommendation: Use `contentInset={{ bottom: dynamicValue }}` so the OS shifts the content instead of relaying it out, which avoids the jump.

rule.title: flex on contentContainerStyle collapses container
rule.recommendation: In RN, `flex: 1` on `contentContainerStyle` sets `flexBasis: 0` and can collapse the container on small screens. Use `flexGrow: 1` instead.

rule.title: Platform-specific shadow keys over boxShadow
rule.recommendation: These shadow keys only work on one platform. On the New Architecture, use a CSS `boxShadow` string like `boxShadow: "0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)"`, which works on both.

rule.title: ARIA button handles only one activation key
rule.recommendation: Use a native button, or make a custom role button activate with both Enter and Space.

rule.title: Role missing required ARIA props
rule.recommendation: Add every required `aria-*` attribute so assistive tech can expose the role's state correctly.

rule.title: Unsupported ARIA prop for role
rule.recommendation: Only use `aria-*` attributes that the element's role supports.

rule.title: Hook called conditionally
rule.recommendation: Call hooks at the top level of a React function component or custom Hook so React sees the same hook order on every render.

rule.title: scope attribute on non-th element
rule.recommendation: Remove `scope` from this element or move it to the related `<th>` cell.

rule.title: Hardcoded secret fallback for env var
rule.recommendation: Remove the literal fallback and fail closed (throw when the variable is unset). The hardcoded value is a committed secret, and the `??`/`||` default makes the app run with it in any environment that forgot to set the var.

rule.title: Element not self-closing
rule.recommendation: Use `<X />` for childless elements so empty closing tags do not add noise.

rule.title: Blocking side effect before response
rule.recommendation: `import { after } from 'next/server'`, then wrap it: `after(() => analytics.track(...))`. The response sends right away.

rule.title: Unauthenticated server action can be called directly
rule.recommendation: Check auth before changing server state or invoking billable services because exported server actions can be called directly by unauthenticated clients.

rule.title: React.cache with object literal
rule.recommendation: Pass plain values like strings or numbers, not an object. React.cache() matches the exact value, so a new `{}` each render misses the cache.

rule.title: Duplicate data in server props
rule.recommendation: Pass the source array once and build the other version on the client. Sending both ships the data twice to the browser.

rule.title: Fetch without revalidate
rule.recommendation: Pass `{ next: { revalidate: <seconds> } }` (or `cache: "no-store"`) so old data doesn't stick around.

rule.title: Static file read on every request
rule.recommendation: Move the read to module scope so it runs once at load: `const FONT_DATA = await fetch(new URL('./fonts/Inter.ttf', import.meta.url)).then(r => r.arrayBuffer())`.

rule.title: Mutable module state on the server
rule.recommendation: Keep per-request data inside the action, or in headers, cookies, or `React.cache`. Module-scope `let`/`var` is shared by every request.

rule.title: Sequential independent awaits
rule.recommendation: These two awaits don't depend on each other. Wrap them in `Promise.all([...])` so they run at the same time.

rule.title: Tabs trigger is outside TabsList
rule.recommendation: Render each imported TabsTrigger inside its library TabsList so keyboard navigation and tablist semantics share one scope.

rule.title: State initialized in constructor
rule.recommendation: Use one class-state setup pattern so readers know where initial state lives.

rule.title: Style prop is not an object
rule.recommendation: Pass `style` as an object so React can apply CSS properties instead of ignoring a string style value.

rule.title: Duplicate CSS property in styled block
rule.recommendation: Merge repeated declarations of the same CSS property in a styled block into one, so a later conditional value doesn't silently override an earlier one.

rule.title: Non-transient custom prop on styled intrinsic element
rule.recommendation: Prefix custom styled-components props with `$` (e.g. `$active`) so styled-components v6 keeps them off the DOM node instead of forwarding them as invalid attributes.

rule.title: Client writes Supabase authorization field
rule.recommendation: Use RLS policies based on `auth.uid()` and server-owned membership rows; do not trust client-provided owner, org, or role columns.

rule.title: Permissive Supabase RLS policy
rule.recommendation: Keep public-read policies explicit, but gate inserts, updates, deletes, and service-role bypasses behind `auth.uid()` plus trusted tenant membership.

rule.title: Supabase table created without Row Level Security
rule.recommendation: Enable RLS in the same migration (`alter table <name> enable row level security;`) and add `auth.uid()`-scoped policies for select/insert/update/delete. A public table without RLS is fully readable and writable with the public anon key.

rule.title: SVG-filtered iframe clickjacking primitive
rule.recommendation: Avoid filtering cross-origin iframes. Use `frame-ancestors` on sensitive pages and keep SVG filters away from embedded privileged UI.

rule.title: Positive tabindex value
rule.recommendation: Use `tabIndex={0}` (focusable in source order) or `tabIndex={-1}` (focus only in code).

rule.title: Mutation in GET server function
rule.recommendation: Use `createServerFn({ method: 'POST' })` for data changes. GET requests can be prefetched and are open to CSRF.

rule.title: Sequential awaits in loader
rule.recommendation: Use `const [a, b] = await Promise.all([fetchA(), fetchB()])` to avoid request waterfalls in route loaders

rule.title: Root route missing HeadContent
rule.recommendation: Add `<HeadContent />` inside `<head>` in your __root route. Without it, route `head()` meta tags are dropped.

rule.title: Root route missing Scripts
rule.recommendation: Render `<Scripts />` near the end of `<body>` in your __root route so TanStack Start can load client-side JavaScript.

rule.title: Plain anchor reloads TanStack Router navigation
rule.recommendation: Use `Link` from `@tanstack/react-router` so internal navigation keeps client state, preloading, and typed routes.

rule.title: Direct fetch in route loader
rule.recommendation: Use `createServerFn()` from @tanstack/react-start for type-safe RPC, input validation, and proper server/client code splitting

rule.title: Dynamic server function import
rule.recommendation: Use `import { myFn } from '~/utils/my.functions'`. The bundler only swaps server code for RPC stubs on static imports.

rule.title: navigate() called during render
rule.recommendation: Use `throw redirect({ to: '/path' })` in `beforeLoad` or `loader`. navigate() during render causes hydration issues.

rule.title: Secret exposed in a loader
rule.recommendation: Loaders are isomorphic (run on both server and client). Wrap secret access in `createServerFn()` so it stays server-only

rule.title: Redundant use server in handler
rule.recommendation: TanStack Start handles server boundaries automatically via the Vite plugin. "use server" inside createServerFn causes compile errors.

rule.title: fetch inside useEffect in route
rule.recommendation: Fetch data in the route `loader` instead. The router loads it before rendering and avoids waterfalls.

rule.title: redirect() inside try-catch
rule.recommendation: TanStack Router's `redirect()` and `notFound()` throw special errors caught by the router. Move them outside the try block or re-throw in the catch

rule.title: Route property order breaks type inference
rule.recommendation: Follow the route property order because TanStack Router's type inference depends on earlier properties feeding later ones.

rule.title: Server function method order breaks type inference
rule.recommendation: Chain methods in order: .middleware() → .validator() → .client() → .server() → .handler(). Types depend on this sequence.

rule.title: Server function without input validation
rule.recommendation: Add `.validator(schema)` before `.handler()`. This data crosses the network and must be validated at runtime.

rule.title: Tenant-controlled static asset proxy
rule.recommendation: Bind tenant identity to the trusted host or authenticated org, canonicalize after decoding, reject traversal, and never let one tenant choose another tenant's asset prefix.

rule.title: Unbounded Three.js device pixel ratio
rule.recommendation: Cap renderer pixel ratio, commonly at 2, so high-density displays do not multiply GPU work without a bound

rule.title: Too many shadow-casting Three.js point lights
rule.recommendation: Keep at most two shadow-casting point lights in one scene, or use cheaper directional, spot, baked, or fake shadows

rule.title: Three.js allocation inside pointer-move handler
rule.recommendation: Reuse vectors, raycasters, and other Three.js objects while handling continuous pointer movement

rule.title: Async Three.js animation callback
rule.recommendation: Keep animation callbacks synchronous; start asynchronous work outside the loop and consume completed state during frames

rule.title: Three.js clone inside animation loop
rule.recommendation: Clone once before the animation loop or copy values into a reusable scratch object during frames

rule.title: Material recompiled inside animation loop
rule.recommendation: Change material defines or features outside the animation loop and set needsUpdate only when the compiled program must change

rule.title: Allocation inside Three.js animation loop
rule.recommendation: Allocate reusable objects before the animation loop and mutate them in place during each frame

rule.title: Three.js object constructed during React render
rule.recommendation: Construct mutable Three.js objects in a stable initializer, effect, event, or module scope instead of recreating them during React render

rule.title: Redundant uniformsNeedUpdate inside animation loop
rule.recommendation: Mutate ShaderMaterial uniform values directly; Three.js uploads custom uniforms during rendering

rule.title: React state update inside Three.js animation loop
rule.recommendation: Mutate Three.js objects or refs during frames; reserve React state for guarded, infrequent transitions

rule.title: React state update inside Three.js pointer-move handler
rule.recommendation: Keep continuous pointer previews in Three.js objects or refs and publish React state when the interaction commits

rule.title: onBeforeCompile variant lacks a program cache key
rule.recommendation: Return every mutable shader-patch variant from customProgramCacheKey on the same material

rule.title: Repeated Three.js meshes use separate draw calls
rule.recommendation: Replace repeated Mesh objects that share geometry and material with one InstancedMesh and per-instance transforms

rule.title: Raw fragment shader lacks float precision
rule.recommendation: Declare a default fragment float precision or qualify every floating-point declaration

rule.title: Raw shader uses GLSL 3 syntax without GLSL3
rule.recommendation: Set glslVersion to THREE.GLSL3 when RawShaderMaterial uses GLSL 3 syntax

rule.title: Unreleased Three.js animation mixer actions
rule.recommendation: Stop component-owned AnimationMixer actions and uncache their owned root in React cleanup

rule.title: Undisposed imperative Three.js controls
rule.recommendation: Dispose component-owned Three.js controls in a React cleanup so their DOM listeners are removed

rule.title: Frame-rate-dependent Three.js animation
rule.recommendation: Scale incremental transforms and interpolation by Clock.getDelta(), use delta-aware damping, or assign from absolute animation time

rule.title: Three.js instanced mesh buffer is not marked for upload
rule.recommendation: After setMatrixAt or setColorAt, set the matching instance buffer's needsUpdate flag to true

rule.title: Locally owned Three.js geometry is not disposed
rule.recommendation: Dispose locally constructed geometries when their React owner releases them

rule.title: Locally owned Three.js material is not disposed
rule.recommendation: Dispose locally constructed materials when their React owner releases them

rule.title: Locally owned Three.js texture is not disposed
rule.recommendation: Dispose locally constructed textures when their React owner releases them

rule.title: Undisposed Three.js postprocessing resource
rule.recommendation: Dispose component-owned postprocessing composers and resource-owning passes

rule.title: Missing Three.js camera projection-matrix update
rule.recommendation: Call camera.updateProjectionMatrix() after changing projection properties so Three.js renders the new frustum

rule.title: Undisposed Three.js render target
rule.recommendation: Dispose component-owned render targets in a React cleanup that follows the render target binding

rule.title: Undisposed Three.js renderer
rule.recommendation: Dispose component-owned renderers and stop their animation loop or animation frame in matching React cleanup

rule.title: Shader uses a constant out-of-bounds index
rule.recommendation: Keep constant array, vector, and matrix indices within their declared bounds

rule.title: Shader derivative runs in non-uniform control flow
rule.recommendation: Evaluate derivatives and implicit-LOD texture samples before fragment-input-dependent branches

rule.title: Shader uses invalid clamp bounds
rule.recommendation: Keep clamp minVal less than or equal to maxVal

rule.title: Shader uses invalid constant bit operations
rule.recommendation: Keep shift counts and bitfield ranges within the integer bit width

rule.title: Shader uses invalid constant math
rule.recommendation: Keep constant arguments within the defined GLSL builtin and operator domains

rule.title: Shader uses invalid smoothstep edges
rule.recommendation: Keep smoothstep edge0 below edge1 and invert the result when a descending transition is needed

rule.title: Shader inverts a uniform matrix per invocation
rule.recommendation: Compute uniform matrix inverses once on the CPU and upload the result

rule.title: ShaderMaterial redeclares a Three.js builtin
rule.recommendation: Use ShaderMaterial built-in attributes and uniforms without redeclaring them

rule.title: Shader redundantly writes fragment depth
rule.recommendation: Let fixed-function depth supply gl_FragCoord.z when depth is unchanged

rule.title: Three shader source contains a version directive
rule.recommendation: Set glslVersion on the material instead of writing #version in shader source

rule.title: Shader uses pow for a small integer exponent
rule.recommendation: Use explicit multiplication for powers of two, three, or four

rule.title: Shader compares a computed distance
rule.recommendation: Compare squared vector distance against a squared nonnegative threshold

rule.title: Shader stages declare incompatible uniforms
rule.recommendation: Use the same type, array dimensions, and precision for uniforms shared by both shader stages

rule.title: Shader stage interface does not match
rule.recommendation: Declare every statically used fragment input as a compatible vertex output with the same name

rule.title: Vertex shader leaves gl_Position undefined
rule.recommendation: Assign gl_Position before every return and on every path through main

rule.title: Shader uniform has no material binding
rule.recommendation: Add every custom GLSL uniform to the ShaderMaterial uniforms object with a compatible value

rule.title: JavaScript branch reads a TSL uniform value
rule.recommendation: Express uniform-dependent shader control flow with TSL If, select, or Loop nodes so it runs on the GPU

rule.title: Legacy EffectComposer used with WebGPURenderer
rule.recommendation: Use WebGPURenderer's node-based post-processing pipeline instead of the legacy WebGL EffectComposer

rule.title: Legacy material API used with WebGPURenderer
rule.recommendation: Use Three.js node materials and TSL for custom shaders rendered by WebGPURenderer

rule.title: Unescaped JSON in HTML or script sink
rule.recommendation: JSON.stringify does not HTML-escape, so a `</script>` (or `<`) in the data breaks out and becomes XSS. Use an HTML-safe serializer (serialize-javascript, devalue) or escape `<`, `>`, and `&`, or pass data via a JSON `<script type="application/json">` read with JSON.parse.

rule.title: Server fetch follows redirects for caller-shaped URL
rule.recommendation: Use `redirect: "manual"` or equivalent and re-validate every redirect target before following it to avoid SSRF redirect bypasses.

rule.title: URL pre-fills a privileged action
rule.recommendation: Require server-side validation and explicit confirmation for URL-sourced invite, role, permission, redirect, or sharing parameters.

rule.title: Full Framer Motion import
rule.recommendation: Use `import { LazyMotion, m } from "framer-motion"` with `domAnimation` features. Saves about 30kb.

rule.title: Valtio proxy read during render
rule.recommendation: Read reactive render values from useSnapshot. Reserve the mutable proxy for event handlers, effects, and other callbacks that need the latest value.

rule.title: Valtio snapshot read in a callback
rule.recommendation: Read from the original Valtio proxy inside callbacks. `useSnapshot()` results are for render reads; callback reads can become tracked render dependencies and cause extra re-renders.

rule.title: Children on a void element
rule.recommendation: Remove the children or use a non-void tag so React does not drop content the element cannot render.

rule.title: Web Animation starts during render
rule.recommendation: Start element.animate() from an effect or interaction handler so React renders stay pure.

rule.title: Invalid Web Animation keyframe offsets
rule.recommendation: Keep explicit Web Animation keyframe offsets between 0 and 1 and in nondecreasing order.

rule.title: Synchronous GPU readback inside animation loop
rule.recommendation: Move GPU readback to a discrete or asynchronous path and reuse the latest completed result during frames

rule.title: Webhook handler lacks signature verification
rule.recommendation: Verify provider signatures before parsing or acting on webhook bodies. Use provider SDK helpers or HMAC verification with timing-safe comparison.

rule.title: window.open without noopener
rule.recommendation: Pass `'noopener'` in the third features argument of `window.open` so the opened page can't control your tab through `window.opener`. Add `'noreferrer'` too when the destination must not receive the referrer.

rule.title: Zod 3 error API breaks in Zod 4
rule.recommendation: Use the Zod 4 helpers instead: `z.treeifyError()`, `z.flattenError()`, `z.prettifyError()`, or read `error.issues` directly.

rule.title: Zod 3 error customization breaks in Zod 4
rule.recommendation: In Zod 4, use the single `{ error }` option instead of message strings, `invalid_type_error`, `required_error`, or `errorMap`.

rule.title: Zod 3 schema API breaks in Zod 4
rule.recommendation: Switch to the Zod 4 versions: top-level factories like `z.enum()`, object helpers like `z.strictObject()`, the new `z.function({ input, output })` form, and explicit key/value schemas for `z.record()`.

rule.title: Format method on z.string()
rule.recommendation: Use the Zod 4 top-level format checks like `z.email()`, `z.uuid()`, or `z.ipv4()` instead of `z.string().<format>()`.

rule.title: Zustand selector returns a fresh value
rule.recommendation: Select a stable store field, split the selector, or wrap a collection selector with `useShallow`.

rule.title: Zustand get() called during store initialization
rule.recommendation: Move the read into a deferred store action or derive the initial value without calling `get()`.

rule.title: Zustand state mutated in place
rule.recommendation: Create a new object, array, Map, or Set before passing the updated value to Zustand.

rule.title: Whole Zustand store subscribed during render
rule.recommendation: Pass a selector to the Zustand hook so this component rerenders only when the state it reads changes.
